title: Tech Lead (m/f/d)
description: <p><strong>At Superchat, we're rebuilding how businesses talk to their customers. The phone call, the contact form, the support ticket: all of it is being replaced by messaging and AI. We're building the platform that runs underneath.</strong></p> <p>Founded in 2020, Superchat has become the platform of choice for <strong>10,000+ businesses worldwide</strong>, from globally recognized brands like Allianz, Auto1, Enpal, Danone, and GASAG to the small businesses, dental practices, and one-person startups that need to look bigger than they are. Today, <strong>millions of messages flow through Superchat every single day</strong>.</p> <p>We started as a unified inbox: one place for every channel a customer might pick, WhatsApp, email, SMS, Instagram. Then ChatGPT happened, and the second chapter began: AI agents that respond across chat, email, and voice at the quality of the best human teams.</p> <p>We're <strong>100 people</strong>, <strong>profitable</strong>, and have raised <strong>€18M in funding</strong> (last round 4.5 years ago, we've been growing on our own money since). Headquartered in Berlin.</p> <p>We are hiring a backend-leaning Tech Lead to lead a team of 3-4 engineers and own the tech for a part of Superchat’s product.</p> <p>This is a hands-on leadership role: You’ll spend roughly half your time designing and building software and the other half enabling your team to perform at its best. Work directly on architecture, development and important projects while creating the clarity, feedback and environment your engineers need to deliver an excellent product</p> <h4><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Who We Want</strong></span></h4> <p><strong>A strong, current backend engineer.</strong><br>You bring 3+ years of experience as a Senior or Staff Engineer and remain deeply involved in software development. You are comfortable owning, designing and building crucial parts of production systems.</p> <p><strong>Experienced with the JVM ecosystem.</strong><br>You have substantial experience with Java or another JVM language. Kotlin and AWS experience are a plus, since our backend runs on Kotlin/Quarkus.</p> <p><strong>Ready to lead people.</strong><br>You may already have worked in a hybrid Tech Lead role, have been an Engineering manager for a short time or be taking your first steps in people leadership after successfully owning projects and architecture. What matters is that you genuiely want to help people grow</p> <p><strong>Strong at delivery.</strong><br>You know how to turn product goals into reality. You are used to work in fast-paced startups and are a driver to increase velocity.</p> <p><strong>Product-minded.</strong><br>You care about solving the customers problem. You engage with product decisions, challenge assumptions constructivly and find pragmatic solutions to build things in a lean way.</p> <p><strong>Clear communicator.</strong><br>You are able to explain complex technical things in details to Engineers and in an understandable way to non-technical stakeholders. You create alignment and motivate people&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Excited about AI-assisted development.</strong><br>You are already using AI in your development workflow and are eager to explore how it can improve engineering speed, quality and the way teams work.</p> <h4><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Who We Don’t Want</strong></span></h4> <p><strong>Pure people manager.<br></strong>You no longer want to work directly on software. This role requires meaningful, ongoing involvement in architecture, implementation, code review, and technical problem-solving.</p> <p><strong>Hero engineer.<br></strong>You want to make every important technical decision yourself or become the bottleneck for the team. Your job is to raise the effectiveness of the whole team, not to be the only person who can solve difficult problems.</p> <p><strong>Pure delivery manager.<br></strong>You treat engineering as a ticketing operation focused only on timelines and task tracking instead of product quality, technical health, and team growth. We need engineering leaders, not project coordinators.</p> <p><strong>Remote-only operator.<br></strong>You prefer fully remote work and don’t want to actively build relationships and culture in person with the team. We believe strong engineering leadership requires regular in-person collaboration and presence in Berlin.</p> <h4><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Your Day To Day</strong></span></h4> <ul> <li>Spend approximately 50% of your time contributing directly to architecture, development, code reviews, and important technical projects.</li> <li>Lead a team of 3–4 engineers and take responsibility for its effectiveness, technical quality, and delivery.</li> <li>Work closely with your Product Manager to understand customer problems, shape solutions, scope projects, and set priorities.</li> <li>Establish clear technical direction while enabling engineers to own decisions and develop their judgment.</li> <li>Run regular 1:1s, give actionable feedback, and support each engineer’s development and performance.</li> <li>Remove blockers, manage dependencies, and help the team identify delivery risks early.</li> <li>Improve engineering practices and explore effective uses of AI throughout the software-development lifecycle.</li> <li>Contribute to hiring through technical interviews, structured feedback, and candidate conversations.</li> </ul> <h4><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Stakeholders</strong></span></h4> <p><strong>Director of Engineering:</strong> Your manager and partner on people development, calibration, processes.<br><strong>Direct Reports: </strong>Engineers in your team; you own their development, performance and growth<br><strong>Product Manager:</strong> PMs own what and why; you own how (delivery) and who (people)<br><strong>CTO and CPO: </strong>We are a lean organization with a flat hierarchy. You will regulary disccuss the direction of architecture with the CTO and product with the CPO</p> <h4><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Why People Choose Us</span></h4> <p><strong>Mission that matters. </strong>Real impact on small businesses, not abstract metrics</p> <p><strong>Funded with conviction. </strong>$16.5M raised and profitable</p> <p><strong>Modern stack. </strong>Kotlin/Quarkus, AWS, TypeScript/React/Next.js, and LangGraph for AI-powered features</p> <p><strong>Squad-based organization. </strong>Each squad owns its domain end-to-end with real ownership and autonomy</p> <p><strong><span class="notion-enable-hover" data-token-index="0">Two clear career tracks</span>.</strong> We support both individual contributor growth (up to Staff level) and Management Paths with explicit reversibility between both and Tech Lead being the first level of management that is still quite hands-on</p> <p><strong>Product-led structure. </strong>PMs report directly to the CPO, keeping product strategy focused, consistent, and clearly prioritized</p> <p><strong>Hybrid by design. </strong>Our Berlin office in Prenzlauer Berg is the center of gravity, with two work-from-home days as the standard setup</p> <p><strong>Direct feedback culture. </strong>Honest, direct, and kind feedback is part of how we work together - in 1:1s, retrospectives, and everyday collaboration</p> <p><strong>Two clear career tracks. </strong>We support both Individual Contributor growth (up to Staff level) and Engineering Management paths, with explicit reversibility between both</p> <p><strong>Benefits &amp; Culture</strong></p> <ul> <li>Choose between an Urban Sports Club/John Reed membership or a public transport/Dance subscription</li> <li>Regular company and team events</li> <li>Annual personal development budget of €500 for conferences, courses, books, career coaching, and more</li> <li>An inclusive and exciting startup culture that enables fast professional and personal growth</li> <li>Beautiful office in the heart of Berlin (Prenzlauer Allee 242) with free snacks, drinks, and top-notch equipment</li> </ul> <p><strong>We want to build a community, not just a company.</strong></p> <p>It’s important to us to create an environment where people genuinely enjoy spending time together - whether that’s through HYROX training, golfing, beer pong tournaments, running clubs, Warhammer, weekend activities, or whatever kind of community you’d like to help build here!</p> <p><strong>We're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the description. At Superchat, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously.</strong></p> <p><strong>Relocating to Berlin? We support you with practical relocation help. You'll feel home in no time.</strong></p> <p><strong>We look forward to your application! 🙂</strong></p> <p><strong>With your application you agree to our&nbsp;<a href="https://www.notion.so/f601741cb4f24d418411aa0ff86c3787?pvs=21">privacy policy.</a></strong></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><img src="https://i.imgur.com/Uicf3C7.jpg" alt="" width="800" style="max-width: 100%;"></p></div> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About The Company</strong></p> <p>GROPYUS is a technology-based construction company focused on building multi-story residential buildings. Thanks to its prefabricated building system with various design options, industrial offsite construction, and fully digitalized processes, the company manufactures aspirational, sustainable, and affordable homes using timber construction methods. GROPYUS is using scalable construction and manufacturing solutions to tap into a future market, boost Europe's strength in innovation, while also playing a substantial role in improving sustainability.</p></div><h3><strong>Über die Rolle</strong></h3> <p>Als Architekt:in mit Schwerpunkt in den Leistungsphasen 2–4 bist du Teil unseres interdisziplinären Planungsteams bei GROPYUS und arbeitest aktiv an der Entwicklung und Umsetzung innovativer Wohngebäude mit.</p> <p>Du begleitest unsere Projekte von der Entwurfsplanung bis zur Genehmigungsplanung und arbeitest dabei eng mit internen Fachplaner:innen, Projektleitungen sowie unserem Building System Team zusammen. Durch deine strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise trägst du dazu bei, hochwertige, effiziente und nachhaltige Wohngebäude zu realisieren.</p> <p>In deiner Rolle übernimmst du Verantwortung für die planerische Ausarbeitung von Projekten, koordinierst Schnittstellen innerhalb des Planungsteams und bringst deine Erfahrung im Wohnungsbau sicher in die Projektarbeit ein. Der Schwerpunkt liegt auf einer qualitativ hochwertigen Planung, einer engen interdisziplinären Zusammenarbeit sowie der digitalen Planung in Revit.</p> <h3><strong>Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Erstellung und Bearbeitung von Entwurfs-, Genehmigungs- und Ausführungsgrundlagen in Revit</li> <li>Entwicklung architektonischer Lösungen unter title: Director of Product Marketing and Market Research (m/w/d)
description: <div class="content-intro"><h4><strong>Help make the world more hospitable </strong></h4> <p>The hospitality industry is uniquely human, and it deserves technology that’s just as inspiring as the people behind it. At Mews, we’re transforming the industry with a platform that helps hotels run smarter, move faster and create better guest experiences.</p> <p>You’ll work with smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do. You’ll have autonomy and the trust to make good decisions and move quickly. And you’ll enjoy a real sense of purpose as you see the impact of what we’re building.</p> <p>If you’re motivated by ownership, curiosity and meaningful impact, and are driven to deliver consistent high performance, you’ll feel at home here.</p> <h4><strong>About the role</strong></h4> <p>Let's get into the specifics. It’s impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this:</p></div><h2>POSITION OVERVIEW</h2> <p>Product marketing at Mews is at a turning point. The function has been effective at launching products; what it has not yet built is the strategic layer that comes after launch – the continuous positioning, adoption strategy, and market intelligence that makes each product more valuable over time. This role owns that shift.</p> <p>The Director of Product Marketing and Market Research is a combined senior leadership role responsible for two things that should never have been separated: how Mews brings products to market, and how Mews understands the market it operates in. You will lead the product marketing team, own the research and customer insights function, and serve as the go-to authority on both disciplines for senior leadership across the business.</p> <p>Mews operates across property management, fintech and payments, guest experience, and marketplace. The right person for this role knows how to build a coherent positioning story across a complex multi-product portfolio – and how to ground that story in real market intelligence, customer insight, and competitive understanding rather than assumption.</p> <h2>RESPONSIBILITIES</h2> <h3>Product marketing strategy</h3> <ul> <li> <p>Define and own product marketing strategy across the Mews portfolio – covering positioning, messaging, and go-to-market execution from launch through adoption and ongoing engagement.</p> </li> <li> <p>Build and govern the global product launch framework so that launches are scalable and repeatable, with clear handoffs between strategy and execution.</p> </li> <li> <p>Own product adoption and post-launch engagement strategy – moving the function beyond launch execution to continuous market thinking that drives usage, retention, and revenue contribution.</p> </li> <li> <p>Partner with Product, Sales, RevOps, and Customer Success to ensure product marketing strategy connects to commercial outcomes and is reflected in how the business goes to market.</p> </li> <li> <p>Own NPS tracking programs and design the measurement framework for product marketing impact, including product attach rates, adoption metrics, and pipeline contribution.</p> </li> </ul> <h3>Market research and customer insights</h3> <ul> <li> <p>Own the end-to-end market research function: identifying research opportunities, designing methodology, running studies, synthesising findings, and activating insights across the business.</p> </li> <li> <p>Lead primary and secondary research initiatives that inform strategic, commercial, and product decisions – including competitive analysis, customer behaviour, market sizing, and buyer intelligence.</p> </li> <li> <p>Build competitive intelligence as a structured, ongoing discipline – not a one-off project. Translate competitive signals into positioning decisions, sales enablement, and product roadmap input.</p> </li> <li> <p>Serve as the functional authority on what the market is telling Mews, and translate that into insight narratives that influence senior leadership decisions and business strategy.</p> </li> <li> <p>Work closely with Strategy, Product, RevOps, and Marketing to ensure insights land where decisions get made, not just where they get read.</p> </li> </ul> <h3>Team and function leadership</h3> <ul> <li> <p>Lead and develop a team of product marketers, setting clear expectations, building capability, and creating a culture of commercial accountability.</p> </li> <li> <p>Set the operating model for how the team works with AI – determining where AI handles execution tasks and where human judgment is irreplaceable, and building team-level standards accordingly.</p> </li> <li> <p>Serve as the senior leadership go-to on product marketing and market intelligence – the person any executive can trust for a well-grounded, commercially-connected answer.</p> </li> <li> <p>Represent product marketing and research in executive forums, contributing to annual planning and portfolio prioritisation decisions.</p> </li> </ul> <h2>REQUIREMENTS</h2> <h3>Professional knowledge and experience</h3> <ul> <li> <p>10+ years in B2B SaaS marketing, with the majority of that time in product marketing – not demand generation, not agency, not brand-only roles.</p> </li> <li> <p>Has held a Director, Senior Director, or Head of Product Marketing title, or a broader marketing leadership title that included ownership of the product marketing function.</p> </li> <li> <p>Proven track record managing and developing a multi-person product marketing team, including hiring, coaching, and performance management.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience owning or significantly contributing to a market research or customer insights function – primary research methodology, competitive intelligence programs, or voice-of-customer work.</p> </li> <li> <p>Deep understanding of B2B SaaS go-to-market strategy: positioning, messaging architecture, pricing and packaging alignment, sales enablement, and lifecycle marketing.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience building or significantly reshaping a product marketing function – not just managing an inherited one.</p> </li> <li> <p>Has operated in a lean, fast-moving environment such as a scale-up, growth-stage, or pre-IPO company. Experience only in large enterprise environments with unlimited resources is unlikely to be a strong fit.</p> </li> </ul> <h3>Skills and capabilities</h3> <ul> <li> <p>Owns GTM strategy end-to-end – from initial positioning through post-launch adoption and continuous market engagement. Experience limited to launch execution is not sufficient.</p> </li> <li> <p>Connects product marketing directly to revenue outcomes. Can articulate how their work has influenced pipeline, product attach rates, adoption, or retention – not just campaign outputs.</p> </li> <li> <p>Translates research into business decisions – not just insight reports. Has a track record of research that changed a strategic or commercial direction.</p> </li> <li> <p>Multi-functional marketing experience beyond product marketing, for example content, SEO, digital, demand generation, or go-to-market strategy.</p> </li> <li> <p>Metrics-driven. Comfortable defining and owning the measurement framework for both product marketing impact and research quality.</p> </li> <li> <p>Strong senior stakeholder communication. Able to influence executive decisions, present with authority, and earn trust through substance rather than seniority alone.</p> </li> <li> <p>Publicly visible in the product marketing or insights community – speaker, writer, or recognised contributor to the discipline. Not a requirement, but a meaningful differentiator.</p> </li> </ul> <h3>AI fluency</h3> <p>AI is changing the product marketing function in a way that is more structural than any other recent technology shift. A significant part of this role is deciding what that means for the team at Mews – what AI handles, what stays human, and how to build a team that operates at a higher strategic level as execution work is automated.</p> <p>We expect this person to: use AI tools deliberately and with criteria; describe specific examples of AI changing how they or their team works strategically; have a point of view on where the product marketing function is heading as AI matures; and build team-level standards for AI use, including how to review and quality-control AI-assisted outputs before they reach senior stakeholders or customers.</p> <h2>NICE TO HAVE</h2> <ul> <li> <p>Fintech, payments, or financial services product marketing experience.</p> </li> <li> <p>Hospitality, travel tech, or hotel SaaS background.</p> </li> <li> <p>Both fintech and hospitality in one profile is the strongest possible combination for this role.</p> </li> <li> <p>DACH region or Germany market experience.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience in a company that has undergone a go-to-market transformation.</p> </li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>Pay Transparency at Mews</strong></h4> <p>Salary ranges are provided in good faith and reflect current market conditions and internal pay structures. Final compensation may be adjusted based on funding, budget constraints, or exceptional candidate qualifications, but will remain within reasonable proximity to the stated range.</p> <p>This salary disclosure is provided in compliance with applicable pay transparency legislation. We are committed to equal pay practices and prohibit salary history inquiries during our recruitment process.</p> <p>If the location you're applying from wasn't originally advertised for this role, salary range information is available upon request at any point during the application/interview process - your recruiter will be able to help.</p> <h4><strong>What’s in it for you?</strong></h4> <p>Our success is powered by our incredible people, supported by benefits that help them thrive.</p> <h4><strong>Global benefits</strong></h4> <p>No matter where you’re based, you’ll enjoy:</p> <ul> <li>Unlimited paid holiday (yes, really)</li> <li>Participation in our company share program</li> <li>Paid parental leave (6 months fully paid for primary caregivers, 2 months for secondary, available after one year of service)</li> <li>An annual Learning budget of €300 (and more for high performers) to support your development</li> <li>Monthly "EDGE" time to Explore, Develop, Grow, and Elevate yourself</li> <li>A work from anywhere policy with flexibility to work abroad for a few weeks each year</li> <li>Relocation options, available after one year</li> <li>Flexible, hybrid working options</li> <li>A home office setup budget to make your workspace your own and a monthly work-from-home allowance</li> <li>Claude tokens, so you can automate workflows and build smarter, more efficient ways of working</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Local benefits</strong></h4> <p>You'll receive additional benefits that vary by location, from healthcare and retirement plans to team events, socials and other perks. Ask us about it during your interview process.</p> <h4><strong>Life at Mews</strong></h4> <p>We’re an equal opportunities employer. We value teams that reflect the diversity of the customers and communities we serve. Different perspectives make better ideas, stronger products and a more welcoming company.</p> <p>We also believe transparency is important when deciding if you're the right fit. Mews is an ambitious, high-pressure environment of continuous learning and high standards. Success here requires resilience, adaptability and a willingness to solve difficult problems.</p> <p>A few things that define how we work:</p> <ul> <li>High autonomy means high responsibility. People are expected to take ownership and drive outcomes. There isn’t a detailed playbook for everything, and that’s part of what makes the work challenging – and rewarding.</li> <li>Change is constant. We’re growing quickly and adapting as we scale. Teams, processes and priorities continue to evolve, and only people who stay curious and agile will thrive.</li> <li>We’re remote-first, not relationship-free. Flexibility is core to how we work, but strong relationships still matter. Our teams are global, so we need expert collaborators and communicators to help us move forward together.</li> <li>AI is an integral part of our processes. What You Bring

  • Proven leadership. You have built and led planning or supply chain teams, and you can develop people while holding a high bar - at KoRo, we lead with clarity and kindness.

Experience in an omnichannel model is ideal; if not omnichannel, retail experience matters more to us than a purely e-commerce background.

title: (Senior) Managing Consultant – Data & Analytics (w/m/d)
description: Deine Aufgaben In dieser Rolle berätst und begleitest du unsere Kunden bei der Entwicklung und Umsetzung datengetriebener Lösungen und übernimmst dabei Verantwortung für Projekte, Teams und die Kundenbeziehung. Du verbindest fachliche und strategische Fragestellungen mit modernen Data-, Analytics- und AI-Technologien, führst Kundenprojekte von der Konzeption bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung und entwickelst gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden nachhaltige Lösungen und neue Geschäftspotenziale. Du verantwortest die Beratung unserer Kunden im Bereich Data & Analytics und begleitest sie von der Entwicklung strategischer Lösungsansätze bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung. Du steuerst und führst Kundenprojekte eigenständig und verantwortest dabei Scope, Qualität, Zeitplan und Budget sowie die Koordination des Projektteams. Du analysierst fachliche Anforderungen, Prozesse und Daten und entwickelst gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden passende technische und fachliche Lösungen – von Datenplattformen und Data Warehouses bis hin zu Analytics- und AI-Lösungen. Du arbeitest hands-on in der Umsetzung mit und bringst deine Expertise beispielsweise bei Datenmodellen, Datenpipelines, Reports, Visualisierungen, KI-Agenten und intelligenten Automatisierungslösungen ein. Du leitest Workshops und Termine auf Kundenseite, moderierst Entscheidungsprozesse und stellst sicher, dass fachliche und technische Perspektiven zu tragfähigen Lösungen zusammengeführt werden. Du baust nachhaltige Kundenbeziehungen auf, erkennst neue Herausforderungen und entwickelst daraus gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden weitere Beratungsansätze und Folgebeauftragungen. Du setzt moderne Technologien wie Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, Power Platform, Azure, SQL, Snowflake oder Databricks gezielt in Kundenprojekten ein und entwickelst unsere Beratungsleistungen kontinuierlich weiter. Du übernimmst fachliche Führung und Coaching von Consultants und Senior Consultants und unterstützt sie dabei, ihre Kompetenzen und Verantwortung im Projekt weiterzuentwickeln. Du wirkst an der Weiterentwicklung unseres Data-&-Analytics-Geschäfts mit – beispielsweise durch die Entwicklung von Best Practices, Methoden und Angeboten sowie durch die Unterstützung bei Presales- und Akquise-Aktivitäten. Dein Profil Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium in (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Mathematik, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung und bringst mehrere Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung in der Beratung oder in Data & Analytics mit. Du verfügst über fundierte Erfahrung in der Konzeption und Umsetzung von Data-&-Analytics-Lösungen und kannst fachliche Anforderungen mit technischen Lösungen verbinden. Du hast Erfahrung in der Steuerung und Leitung von Kundenprojekten und verstehst es, Projekte hinsichtlich Scope, Qualität, Zeit und Budget erfolgreich zu managen. Du trittst gegenüber Kunden souverän und beratungsstark auf, kannst Workshops und Meetings auf Entscheider-Ebene führen und baust langfristige Kundenbeziehungen auf. Du bringst fundierte Kenntnisse in Technologien wie SQL, Power BI, Azure, Microsoft Fabric, Data Engineering, Snowflake oder Databricks mit und hast Freude daran, moderne Technologien zielgerichtet einzusetzen. Du interessierst dich für Künstliche Intelligenz, Generative AI und AI Agents und hast idealerweise bereits Erfahrung darin, AI-Lösungen zu konzipieren oder in Kundenprojekten umzusetzen. Du denkst analytisch, strukturiert und unternehmerisch, erkennst Potenziale beim Kunden und kannst daraus konkrete Lösungen, neue Beratungsansätze und Folgegeschäft entwickeln. Du übernimmst gerne fachliche Führung und Mentoring und hast Freude daran, Consultants und Senior Consultants weiterzuentwickeln sowie Verantwortung im Team zu übernehmen. Du überzeugst durch Eigeninitiative, Kommunikationsstärke und Hands-on-Mentalität, arbeitest gerne an komplexen Fragestellungen und hast sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse sowie eine moderate Reisebereitschaft. Unser Angebot Gestalte Veränderung mit: Du kommst zu einem spannenden Zeitpunkt zu uns und hast die Möglichkeit, einen wegweisenden Veränderungsprozess aktiv mitzugestalten – mit viel Raum für deine fachliche und persönliche Entwicklung. Faire & attraktive Vergütung: Wir bieten dir ein wettbewerbsfähiges Vergütungspaket, das deine Qualifikation, Erfahrung und deinen Verantwortungsbereich berücksichtigt. Learning & Development: Mit der pmOne Academy begleiten wir dich von Anfang an mit einem individuellen Lernpfad und einem persönlichen L&D-Coach. Dazu kommen vielfältige Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten. Hybrid Work: Arbeite flexibel im Homeoffice und nutzen unser modern, zentral gelegenes Office für persönlichen Austausch und Zusammenarbeit im Team. Workation: Du möchtest Arbeit und Tapetenwechsel verbinden? Für einige Wochen im Jahr kannst du mobil aus dem europäischen Ausland arbeiten – auf Wunsch auch in Kombination mit deinem Urlaub. Gesundheit & Wellbeing: Deine Gesundheit ist uns wichtig. Wir unterstützen dein physisches und mentales Wohlbefinden unter anderem mit Zugang zu psychologischer Beratung und Coaching sowie einer großzügigen Bezuschussung sportlicher Aktivitäten. Come as you are: Bei uns zählt der Mensch. Wir leben eine wertschätzende und offene Unternehmenskultur mit flachen Hierarchien, kurzen Entscheidungswegen und gelebter Diversity. Family first & gemeinsam Spaß haben : Beruf und Privatleben sollen zusammenpassen. Deshalb finden wir bei persönlichen oder familiären Anliegen individuelle Lösungen. Und natürlich kommt auch der Spaß nicht zu kurz – bei Firmenevents, gemeinsamen Koch-Aktivitäten, in der Kaffeeküche oder einfach beim Feierabend mit dem Team. raw.description:

sofort


Das erwartet dich

Wir bauen mit unserem Green-Field-Ansatz eine neue Cloud in unseren deutschen Rechenzentren auf — vollständig selbst gehostet, cloud-native und ohne Abhängigkeit von amerikanischen Hyperscalern. Jeder unserer Kunden erhält ein dediziertes Kubernetes-Cluster auf Basis des SUSE-Stacks (Harvester, RKE2), ausgerollt und verwaltet über Fleet, mit eigenem Tenant-Management.

Du bist nicht Betreiber eines fremden Systems, sondern gestaltest die Plattform, auf der unsere Software als SaaS läuft — mit echter Verantwortung und echtem Gestaltungsspielraum.

Digitale Souveränität ist bei uns kein Versprechen, sondern Betriebsrealität. Auf dieser Plattform laufen die geschäftskritischen Anwendungen von Versicherern und Auftraggebern der öffentlichen Hand. Die Anforderungen an Verfügbarkeit, Informationssicherheit und Nachweisbarkeit sind auf allerhöchsten Level. Hierfür sind unsere Managed Services nach BSI C5 testiert.

Das erwartet dich

Plattform entwickeln und gestalten

  • Konzeption, Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung der selbst gehosteten Cloud-Plattform (Multi-Cluster, ohne Hyperscaler-Abhängigkeit, volle Kontrolle)
  • Architektur und Design hochverfügbarer Kubernetes-Cluster im SUSE-Stack, inklusive Networking, Storage, Load Balancing und Authentifizierung
  • Design und Weiterentwicklung des Tenant-Konzepts: isolierte Kundenumgebungen, Verantwortung für Architektur und Lifecycle
  • Abstimmung mit der Entwicklung zu performance- und verfügbarkeitsrelevanten Anforderungen an das Cluster- und Tenant-Konzept
  • Weiterentwicklung des Hochverfügbarkeitskonzepts: Ein verteilter In-Memory Ansatz über mehrere Knoten (Schwarmtechnik), der die Echtzeitfähigkeit der Anwendungen im Normalbetrieb sicherstellt
Automatisieren und standardisieren
  • GitOps-Workflows über ArgoCD und Fleet — von der Erstauslieferung bis zum Day-2-Betrieb vollständig automatisiert
  • Infrastructure as Code mit Ansible, Terraform oder vergleichbaren Tools; Policy as Code für Sicherheit und Governance
  • CI/CD-Integration und Standardisierung der Deployment-Prozesse
Brücke zu den Entwicklungsteams und Kunden
  • Platform Engineering für interne Teams: Aufbau von Self-Service-Fähigkeiten, Definition von Standards, Begleitung des Onboardings
  • Aktive Unterstützung der Entwicklungsteams bei der Migration ihrer Workloads in die Cloud-Plattform
  • Verarbeitung von Erkenntnissen aus dem laufenden Betrieb (Monitoring-Daten, Incidents) zur kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung von Stabilität, Sicherheit und Performance


Das bringst du mit

Must-have

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Cloud- oder Platform-Engineering, in Container-Technologien oder Infrastrukturautomatisierung
  • Fundierte Kubernetes Kenntnisse, idealerweise aus dem Betrieb produktiver Multi-Cluster-Umgebungen
  • Erfahrung mit GitOps-Workflows (idealerweise ArgoCD oder Fleet) und Infrastructure as Code (z. B. Ansible, Terraform)
  • Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse (mind. C1) sowie sehr gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
  • Reisebereitschaft für Kundentermine und Termine an unseren weiteren Standorten
Nice-to-have
  • Erfahrung mit SUSE Stack oder vergleichbaren Kubernetes-Management-Plattformen
  • Kenntnisse in DevSecOps, Policy as Code oder Hochverfügbarkeitskonzepten
  • Erfahrung mit Monitoring-Stacks (z. B. Prometheus, Grafana)
Persönlich
  • Systemisches Denken statt Ticket-Fokus, mit Blick fürs Gesamtbild
  • Sicheres Auftreten und Kommunikation auf Augenhöhe mit Entwicklungsteams wie mit Kunden
  • Strukturierte, eigenständige und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise
  • Erfahrung darin, Themen über Team- und Kundengrenzen hinweg zu steuern

  • Übernimm Verantwortung und nutze deinen Gestaltungsspielraum, um eigene Ideen zu verwirklichen.

title: Global Director of Logistics & Fulfilment
description: <p>More than one third of the food produced in the world is wasted. And that has a huge impact on the health of our planet, with 10% of greenhouse gas emissions coming from food waste!</p> <p>At Too Good To Go, we have an ambitious goal: To inspire and empower everyone to fight food waste together. We are the world's #1 app for fighting food waste and we work with thousands of restaurants and food retailers to make their surplus food available to local consumers. The magic of Too Good To Go has expanded rapidly across Europe, the US, and Canada, with over 500 million meals saved across our 20&nbsp; countries to date.</p> <p>We’re proud of what we’ve achieved so far, but did we mention the issue is huge? We always want to raise the bar and that’s where you come in.</p> <p>Your mission at Too Good to Go…</p> <p>We’re looking for an exceptional Global Director of Logistics &amp; Fulfillment to lead the end-to-end logistics and fulfillment engine behind Parcels across transportation, warehousing, repack, pick/pack, and last-mile delivery. This is a strategic role with a highly operational core: you’ll define the global fulfillment strategy, build the partner ecosystem, and drive the day-to-day performance and continuous improvement needed to scale reliably in an agile, high-growth environment.</p> <p>You will report to the VP Operations, Parcels and sit on the Global Parcels Leadership Team, leading a global organization of 15+ team members across 10+ countries.</p> <p>Our Parcels business is a transformative solution that enables food manufacturers to effectively reduce food waste while extracting value from surplus food. Through direct purchasing from food manufacturers, Too Good To Go carefully curates and assembles the purchased products into bundles, which are then offered to our users at a discount of ~50% off of original retail.&nbsp; Sold through our existing Too Good To Go app, customers can opt to have their orders conveniently delivered to their doorstep or pick it up from a nearby location. Instead of allowing these products to go to waste, manufacturers decrease their environmental impact, optimise their revenue by maximising the value of saved food, and enhance product visibility in the market.</p> <p>In the role, you will:</p> <p><strong>Build and scale a best-in-class fulfillment network (strategy + execution)</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own and optimize the full Parcels logistics value chain: inbound to warehouse, repack/kitting, inventory management, pick/pack, carrier handoff, last-mile delivery, and returns/claims.</li> <li>Architect and execute a logistics and fulfillment strategy that supports cost efficiency, service quality, and international growth.</li> <li>Operate comfortably in ambiguity: create structure fast, make trade-offs, and iterate as we scale.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Own and manage the 3PL and carrier ecosystem</strong></p> <ul> <li>Evaluate, select, and onboard 3PLs, fulfillment partners, and data/visibility providers; negotiate commercial and legal terms and ensure strong governance.</li> <li>Define and implement operational standards with partners: facility/site design, process flows, repack specifications, SOPs, WMS/data integration, ERP migrations and capacity planning.</li> <li>Lead quarterly and annual business reviews; own partner performance against SLAs and drive corrective action when service or cost drifts.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Drive performance through S&amp;OP, planning, and inventory discipline</strong></p> <ul> <li>Be an active driver of the monthly S&amp;OP cadence, connecting and challenging demand forecasts, supply planning, capacity, and operational constraints.</li> <li>Partner closely with Commercial and Supply Planning to maintain healthy inventory: reduce obsolescence, shrink, and write-offs, and improve inventory turns.</li> <li>Build dashboards and operating rhythms that create transparency and decision speed across markets.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Lead teams and cross-functional execution in a matrix</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead and develop a global logistics organization; set clear priorities, empower local leaders, and raise the operational bar across markets.</li> <li>Work shoulder-to-shoulder with Commercial, Marketing, Product, Finance, Projects/CI, and local Operations teams to execute against business goals.</li> <li>Lead complex cross-functional initiatives (e.g., carrier transitions, new country launches, peak readiness, system implementation, process changes).</li> </ul> <p>What success looks like for this role:</p> <ul> <li>A scalable, repeatable fulfillment model that behaves like a modern e-commerce operation: reliable delivery, strong unit economics, and operational control.</li> <li>Strong partner performance and accountability: clear SLAs, measurable outcomes, and continuous improvement.</li> <li>Define and implement service metrics (e.g., on-time delivery, refunds, delivery quality) while driving down cost-to-serve.</li> <li>Inventory health and planning maturity: fewer write-offs, fewer surprises, faster decision cycles.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>What is required for this role:</p> <ul> <li>Experience in senior logistics / fulfillment leadership (or similar), ideally in e-commerce, food delivery, meal kits, retail, or food/CPG supply chain.</li> <li>Proven experience building and managing multi-country logistics operations with multiple 3PLs and carrier partners.</li> <li>Strong track record in warehouse process design and optimization (directly or through 3PLs): pick/pack, repack/kitting, layout, capacity planning.</li> <li>Experience with cross-border and pan-European parcel networks is a strong advantage.</li> <li>Experience in a global matrix organization is a plus.</li> <li>Strong analytical capability (KPIs, dashboards, root-cause problem solving) and planning discipline (S&amp;OP, capacity, inventory).</li> <li>Excellent stakeholder management—able to align teams, challenge constructively, and drive decisions.</li> </ul> <p>You’ll succeed in this role if you are:</p> <ul> <li>A strategic operator: you can design the system and also roll up your sleeves to make it work day to day.</li> <li>Comfortable moving fast: you can deliver outcomes in an agile, iterative environment without waiting for perfect information.</li> <li>Commercially sharp: you understand unit economics, contract levers, and how to scale with partners without losing control.</li> <li>Calm under pressure: you can handle peak periods, partner incidents, and operational fire-fighting while still improving the system.</li> </ul> <p>Our values:</p> <ul> <li>We win together: Food waste is a big beast to fight. We can do it if we win together as Waste Warriors with no ego. We believe in a #oneteam.</li> <li>We raise the bar: We always push for more. We work smart, smash barriers and elevate one another.</li> <li>We keep it simple: Our ambitions are bold but our solutions are simple.</li> <li>We build a legacy: We’re proud of the change we’re driving.&nbsp;</li> <li>We care: We always look out for each other. Caring is also about the way we do business. We do the right thing.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>What we have to offer:</p> <ul> <li>A rare opportunity to work in a social impact company (and certified B Corporation!) where you get to wake up every day knowing you’re achieving positive change.</li> <li>The experience of being part of an international company with 1300+ enthusiastic and highly talented teammates across 20 countries (and growing).</li> <li>Strong personal as well as professional development in an intense and high-growth scale-up environment.</li> <li>An open company culture where you have the independence and room to unleash your creativity.</li> <li>A strong team culture where successes are celebrated together.</li> </ul> <p><br><br></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em data-stringify-type="italic">A Movement for Everyone</em><br><em data-stringify-type="italic">We want to inspire and empower everyone to fight food waste together. With that mission, it’s only natural that we want to build a diverse and inclusive team of highly capable individuals who are passionate about doing things in a better way. We strongly believe we all excel and are more creative when we’re allowed to be ourselves, and we’re committed to a culture where all of us belong.</em><br><em data-stringify-type="italic">We are an equal opportunity employer and all employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit and business need. If you need reasonable accommodation at any point in the application or interview process, please let us know.</em></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Please note that this is a working student position. A minimum availability of 20 hours per week is required for this role.

  • Work closely with the Brand Communications Manager to grow brand awareness across the EMEA region
  • Monitor social media and market trends and the competitive landscape
  • Support the creation and implementation of marketing campaigns across multiple channels, such as social media, email, PR, and influencer partnerships

  • Familiarity with social media platforms, including Instagram, Linkedin and YouTube
  • Knowledge of Mailchimp and WordPress a plus
  • Good command of spoken and written English
  • Students majoring in marketing, communications, or a related field

title: Software Engineer — Software Platform & Middleware (Early Career)
description: Build the Software Platform Powering Next-Generation Mobility Apex.AI is developing the software foundation for autonomous systems, intelligent machines, and software-defined vehicles. We are looking for an early-career Software Engineer to help advance our core software platform technologies, including Apex.Grace and Apex.Ida. This role is ideal for recent university graduates or engineers with 1–2 years of experience who are passionate about modern C++, distributed systems, middleware, developer platforms, and systems software engineering. You will work alongside experienced engineers on high-performance middleware, runtime systems, developer tooling, and software infrastructure used in safety-critical and real-time environments. This is an opportunity to gain hands-on experience building production-quality software for automotive, robotics, aerospace, and industrial automation applications. We are looking for engineers who enjoy solving complex technical problems, learning deeply about software systems, and building tools and platforms that other developers rely on every day. This role is based in our Munich office. What You’ll Do Contribute to the development and maintenance of core software components for Apex.AI products, particularly Apex.Grace and Apex.Ida Help build software platform capabilities, middleware features, developer tooling, and runtime infrastructure Support improvements in performance, reliability, scalability, and maintainability across the platform stack Assist in debugging and resolving complex software and system-level issues Develop automated tests, CI workflows, and engineering tooling Collaborate closely with platform, product, and applications teams to deliver production-quality software Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and software design activities Learn and apply engineering best practices for modern C++ and systems software development Contribute ideas and improvements to developer workflows and platform usability What You Bring Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Mathematics, Robotics, or a related technical field Strong foundation in software engineering and computer science fundamentals Experience with modern C++ through coursework, internships, personal projects, or early professional work Familiarity with Python or scripting languages Experience developing software on Linux-based systems Interest in distributed systems, middleware, runtime systems, or embedded software Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills Familiarity with Git and modern software development workflows Strong written and verbal communication skills Curiosity, ownership mentality, and eagerness to learn new technologies Nice to Have Exposure to middleware or communication technologies such as ROS/ROS 2, DDS, shared memory IPC, or networking APIs Familiarity with TCP/IP, sockets programming, or Linux system programming Experience with CI/CD workflows and automated testing Exposure to robotics, autonomous systems, or embedded software projects Familiarity with build systems such as CMake or Bazel Understanding of distributed systems concepts or real-time systems Interest in automotive software, intelligent machines, or software-defined vehicles Internship or academic experience involving systems programming or developer platforms Why Apex.AI Build foundational platform technology used in real-world autonomous and intelligent systems Learn from highly experienced engineers working on technically challenging problems Gain hands-on experience with middleware, runtime systems, and developer infrastructure Engineering-driven culture with meaningful ownership, mentorship, and growth opportunities Competitive compensation, benefits, and professional development opportunities International team working at the forefront of mobility software innovation About Apex.AI Apex.AI is an international software company specializing in the development of safety-certified, developer-friendly, and scalable software for mobility systems, aiming to accelerate the transition to software-defined vehicles and mobility. Founded in 2017 by Jan Becker and Dejan Pangercic, the company is headquartered in Palo Alto, California, with additional offices in Munich, Stuttgart, Gothenburg, Tokyo, and Pangyo. To date, Apex.AI has raised over $75 million USD from world-class venture, financial and strategic investors including AGCO, Airbus Ventures, Canaan, Continental AG, Daimler Truck, HELLA Ventures, Jaguar Land Rover’s InMotion Ventures, LG Electronics, Lightspeed, Orillion, Toyota Ventures, Volvo Group Venture Capital and ZF. You manage planning, capacities, dependencies, and releases and keep the entire development process in view. You lead our Development Leads and development teams both functionally and disciplinarily. You coordinate teams and tickets throughout their full lifecycle, continuously improve our development and project processes, and ensure transparent and realistic planning for all relevant stakeholders. You are the central interface between Engineering and Product Management. Product owns product strategy, prioritization, and requirements; together with the Development Leads, you ensure these are translated into technically sound, realistically planned, and reliably delivered solutions. This is not a traditional IT project management role: you bring a strong technical background yourself and can make architecture and design decisions together with our Development Leads, assess technical risks, and evaluate different solution approaches. Alongside short-term delivery, you also keep long-term technical topics in view, including architecture, maintainability, security, technical debt, and the continuous improvement of our engineering standards. You actively drive our AI First Development Culture. This goes far beyond AI-assisted coding: you identify opportunities to integrate AI into research, technical conception, architecture, project planning, development, testing, reviews, debugging, documentation, and other development processes, and help the team use these tools effectively. Your profile You have at least 5 years of relevant professional experience in or around software development and have worked hands-on as a software developer yourself. You bring proven experience leading developers and development teams and have already held both functional and disciplinary leadership responsibility. You have experience managing software development projects: you have coordinated multiple developers and stakeholders, owned planning and timelines, managed dependencies, and guided releases through to delivery. You are technically deep enough to understand and shape architecture decisions, identify technical risks early, and discuss technical topics with experienced developers at eye level. You bring strong experience in at least one of our technology areas: Python-based backend development, ideally with Django / Django REST Framework or FastAPI, or modern frontend development with React and TypeScript. Experience with the other area is a plus. You understand modern SaaS architectures, REST APIs, relational databases, and the core challenges involved in developing, operating, and evolving complex web applications. You can balance product requirements, technical possibilities, and available resources and communicate decisions transparently and convincingly. You already use AI tools actively or are deeply engaged with how AI can change development and project processes. You evaluate new tools pragmatically, critically assess their output, and can establish successful workflows across the team. You communicate clearly and convincingly and are equally comfortable coordinating with Engineering, Product Management, and senior management. title: Werkstudent Data QA & Algorithm Benchmarking (m/w/d)
description: Deine Mission syte benutzt komplexe Algorithmen, die auf Basis von 3D-Punktwolken und 3D-Modellen Gebäudemetriken ausrechnen. Typische Beispiele für relevante Metriken sind Geschossfläche, Anzahl Geschosse, Volumen und Gebäudehöhen. Um schnelle Entwicklungszyklen zu gewährleisten, und Änderungen an den Algorithmen auf Knopfdruck quantitativ und automatisiert bewerten zu können, ist syte auf hochwertige QA-Daten angewiesen. Um diesen Datensatz systematisch auszubauen und zu härten und damit die Grundlage, auf der unsere Algorithmen gemessen werden , zu entwickeln, suchen wir dich als Werkstudent Data QA & Algorithm Benchmarking (m/w/d) zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt in Münster. Deine Aufgaben Ground Truth Audit: Du evaluierst die Korrektheit bestehender Testdaten und ermittelst hierfür neue Metriken, die wir zur Evaluation unserer Algorithmen verwenden können. Edge Cases jagen: Du ermittelst neue Testdaten für schwierige Gebäude (z.B. komplexe Dachformen, Bäume über den Dächern) und integrierst diese in den Gesamtdatensatz. Data Sourcing: Du ermittelst potenzielle Quellen für neue Testdatensätze und integrierst diese möglichst automatisiert. Benchmarking & Insights: Du führst unsere Benchmarking-Pipelines aus, um sowohl die Algorithmen als auch die Qualität der Daten quantitativ zu bewerten. Die Ergebnisse dieser Analysen visualisierst und kommunizierst du verständlich, sodass sich daraus Handlungsempfehlungen ableiten. Pipeline Engineering: Du implementierst und testest Verbesserungen in den Benchmarking-Pipelines und den Parametern der Algorithmen. Dein Profil Dein Studium: Du studierst in einem höheren Bachelorsemester oder ersten Mastersemester (Geo-/Wirtschafts-)Informatik oder hast einen Schwerpunkt in Data Science/Statistik. Du hast auch einen gültigen Immatrikulationsnachweis. Analytische Fähigkeiten: Du arbeitest dich gerne tief in Daten ein und begeisterst dich für die statistische Analyse der Daten. Neugierde für die komplexe Daten: Dir gefällt die Arbeit an und das Nachvollziehen von komplexeren Algorithmen in einer anspruchsvollen Domäne. Teamfähigkeit : Du arbeitest mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch und kannst dich gut im Team koordinieren. Sprachkenntnisse : Du sprichst verhandlungssicheres Deutsch (mind. C1) und fließend Englisch (mind. B2). Pluspunkt : Du hast Vorerfahrungen in den Bereichen Architektur oder PropTech und erste Programmiererfahrungen mit Python. Dein Einstiegstermin und Einsatzort Einstiegstermin: zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt Einsatzort: Münster (ca. 1 Tag pro Woche im Office) Anstellungsart: Werkstudium (12-20 Std./Woche, Zeiten flexibel) Deine Benefits Dein attraktives Gehalt: Wir sorgen dafür, dass jeder Aspekt deiner Reise bei syte motivierend ist. Wir kennen deinen Wert! Deine Hardware: Unser syte-Team ist mit modernster Hard- und Software ausgestattet. Dein Team: Einmal im Quartal trifft sich das gesamte Team für zwei Tage zum Arbeiten und um gemeinsam Erfolge zu feiern. Deine Flexibilität: Neben gemeinsamen Workations hast du auch privat die Möglichkeit, aus dem Ausland zu arbeiten. Dein Hund im Büro: Dein vierbeiniger Begleiter ist bei uns herzlich willkommen und darf jederzeit mit dir ins Office kommen. Dein persönliches Benefit-Budget: 2.200,00 € jährlich für das, was dir wichtig ist: Upskilling : Dir steht jeweils ein Budget für betriebliche als auch für private Weiterbildung zur Verfügung. Equipment : Neben der initialen Ausstattung mit modernster Apple-Hardware erhältst du zusätzlich ein Budget für die Ausstattung deines Arbeitsplatzes. Steueroptimierte Benefits : Du kannst dein Budget u. a. für steueroptimierte Angebote wie den steuerfreien Sachbezug, einen Internet-Zuschuss, den Mobilitäts-Zuschuss, eine Erholungsbeihilfe oder einen KITA-Zuschuss nutzen. Gesundheit & Wellbeing : Dein Budget kannst du zudem für alles einsetzen, was Körper und Geist guttut, so z. B. für eine Urban Sports Club Mitgliedschaft, Physiotherapie, Urlaubsreisen etc. BusinessBike : Durch unsere Zusammenarbeit mit BusinessBike kannst du ganz einfach dein Wunschrad leasen. title: Lead / Principal Deployment Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.</p></div><p><strong>The Team</strong></p> <p>Celonis Services is the delivery engine of our Celonis Customer Organization, responsible for turning the Celonis platform into measurable, business-critical outcomes for our customers. In the AI era, our role has elevated: as AI agents like our own Apollo take on more of the technical build, our people focus on the work that drives real impact—understanding our customers' business-critical problems, designing the solutions that solve them, and quantifying the value delivered. Our Deployment Engineers and Deployment Architects pair deep domain and industry expertise with serious platform mastery and AI-augmented delivery, directing agentic systems while owning the judgment, architecture, and customer relationships that AI cannot replace. We deliver faster and smarter than ever, and we own the outcome: solution go-live, solution adoption, initial value realization support and the long-term success of our customers.</p> <p><strong>The Role</strong></p> <p>As a Lead / Principal Deployment Engineer, you are the backbone of Celonis delivery. You lead the hands-on implementation of Celonis solutions for enterprise customers, combining platform expertise with AI-augmented workflows to deliver high-quality outcomes, fast. You use Celonis’s AI deployment tools as your primary instruments - directing agents to build data models, generate analyses, and configure operational solutions, while applying your own judgment to validate outputs, adapt to customer context, and ensure business relevance.</p> <p>This is not a traditional consulting role where you build everything manually. Co-Working Spaces, Lehrwerk-Verlage, unsere externe Zertifizierungs-Stelle), verhandelst Verträge und stellst sicher, dass deren Arbeit zum erfolgreichen Kursverlauf beiträgt. Was du mitbringst Erfahrung: Du hast ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium oder eine /Ausbildung in Bereichen der Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Sozial- oder Naturwissenschaften Du hast mehrere Jahre praktische Erfahrung in dynamischen Start-Up oder Scale-Up Umfeldern, idealerweise mit Multi-Stakeholder Projekten und im Operations Bereich. Kompetenzen: Problemlösungskompetenz: Du kannst dich schnell in die Perspektive Anderer eindenken und proaktiv eigenständige Lösungen finden. Hands-On-MacherIn: Als kleines Team kommt es immer wieder vor, dass spontane & neue Aufgaben anfallen, die im Team verteilt werden. Stakeholder & Projekt Management: Du bist in der Lage, komplexe Projekte zu strukturieren und sicherzustellen, dass definierte Deadlines eingehalten werden in enger Abstimmung mit den jeweiligen Stakeholdern. Gestaltung: Wir glauben an die beste Idee, egal von wem sie kommt. Freue dich also auf viel Freiheiten deine persönlichen Ideen bei uns umzusetzen. Was ist eine Eigenschaft von dir, die nicht direkt auf dem Lebenslauf zu finden ist? Unser Bewerbungsprozess: Dein Profil: Deine Bewerbung geht ein, wir prüfen deinen Lebenslauf und antworten innerhalb von 4-5 Werktagen Kennenlernen: Du bekommst eine Einladung zum Kennenlerngespräch mit unserem Recruiting Manager Chris Heisch (Video-Call, 30 Minuten) Fachgespräch: Im Gespräch mit unserer Gründerin Franziska geht ihr tiefer auf deine bisherigen praktischen Erfahrungen und Kenntnisse in Operations ein (Video-Call, 60 Minuten) Fallstudie: In einer konkreten Fallstudie mit einer aktuellen Herausforderung bei Zukunftsmotor stellst du deine fachliche Expertise unter Beweis vor unserer Gründerin sowie einem weiteren Stakeholder aus der Organisation (vor Ort) Wir melden uns innerhalb einer Woche spätestens bei dir zurück mit unserer Entscheidung Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Software Engineer (m/w/d) | Fullstack für KI-Produkte
description: Über uns Wie bleibt ein RAG-System präzise, wenn aus tausend Dokumenten hunderttausend werden? Wie orchestriert man mehrere Modellanbieter sauber hinter einer Oberfläche? Während anderswo noch Prototypen gezeigt werden, arbeiten unsere Kunden längst damit - mit ihren Daten, ihren Regeln, gehostet in Deutschland. Als Senior Engineer verantwortest du Kernfunktionen und Architektur unserer Plattform, vom Retrieval bis ins Frontend - und du entwickelst sie so, wie wir arbeiten: AI-gestützt, mit Coding-Agents als Teil des Werkzeugkastens und mit echtem Gestaltungsspielraum für deine Ideen. Du suchst eine Rolle, in der technische Tiefe und Produktverantwortung zusammenkommen? Dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen! Das gibt es zu tun Architektur & Umsetzung Du entwirfst und skalierst verteilte Systeme und Microservices - immer mit Blick auf Wartbarkeit, Stabilität und die Frage, was in zwei Jahren noch trägt. KI-Features bauen, die im Alltag halten Du entwickelst die Kernfunktionen unserer Plattform - von RAG-basierten Wissensdatenbanken über KI-Apps für einzelne Fachbereiche bis zu Voice-, Übersetzungs- und Analytics-Funktionen. Full-Stack liefern Du entwickelst performante APIs, modellierst Daten und Datenbanken und setzt moderne Oberflächen im Frontend um - vom Retrieval bis zur Benutzeroberfläche. Daten, Sicherheit & Mandantenfähigkeit Du modellierst Daten für Multi-Tenancy und rollenbasierte Berechtigungen - so, dass niemand über die KI Zugriff auf etwas bekommt, das er nicht sehen darf. Verschlüsselung, Datenminimierung und Auditierbarkeit denkst du von Anfang an mit. Betrieb & Observability mitdenken Du sorgst dafür, dass Qualität, Kosten und Verhalten der KI-Features im Betrieb sichtbar bleiben - mit Evaluations, Monitoring und klaren Guardrails, damit die Plattform auch bei wachsender Nutzung stabil und effizient läuft. Komplexität beherrschen Du entwickelst bestehende Systeme weiter, schaffst klare Strukturen und reduzierst technische Schulden dort, wo sie langfristig teuer werden und lässt sie stehen, wo sie es nicht sind. AI-gestützt entwickeln – und den Standard dafür setzen Du arbeitest selbstverständlich mit Coding-Assistenten und Agenten, holst mehr aus ihnen heraus als Autocomplete und weißt genau, wo ihre Grenzen liegen. Neue Tools und Workflows testest du früh, bewertest sie ehrlich und etablierst im Team, wie wir sie sinnvoll einsetzen. Team & Produkt weiterbringen Du arbeitest eng mit Product Owner, UX und unseren Consultants zusammen, übersetzt echte Kunden-Use-Cases in Technik, machst technische Entscheidungen transparent und bringst unsere Junior Developer durch Code Reviews und Mentoring fachlich weiter. Das bringst Du mit Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der Entwicklung komplexer Softwaresysteme, idealerweise im KI- bzw. SaaS/Cloud-Umfeld Sehr gute TypeScript-Kenntnisse, Erfahrung mit Node.js und idealerweise Frameworks wie NestJS Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Softwarearchitektur für verteilte Systeme - Microservices, API-Design, Skalierung Erfahrung im Frontend, z. B. mit Vue.js, sowie ein gutes Verständnis für Full-Stack-Zusammenhänge Fundierte Kenntnisse im Umgang mit Datenbanken (z. B. PostgreSQL), Datenmodellierung und Performance-Optimierung Erfahrung mit Cloud-Plattformen (z. B. AWS), Docker und dem Betrieb von SaaS-Anwendungen AI-gestütztes Entwickeln ist für dich Alltag: Du arbeitest routiniert mit Coding-Assistenten und -Agenten (z. B. Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot), kennst ihre Grenzen und prüfst generierten Code kritisch, statt ihm zu vertrauen Du bist nah am Puls der Entwicklung: Du probierst neue Tools, Modelle und Workflows aktiv aus und bringst die guten ins Team - Erfahrung mit agentischen Setups (z. B. Coding-Agents in der Cloud, MCP-Integrationen, automatisierte Reviews) ist ein starkes Plus Tieferes Verständnis moderner AI-/LLM-Konzepte wie RAG, Function Calling, Embeddings oder Agenten Clean Code, Testing und Code Reviews sind für dich selbstverständlich und du bringst Junior Developers durch Reviews und Mentoring gern fachlich weiter Du triffst technische Entscheidungen und kannst sie nachvollziehbar vertreten - auf Deutsch und auf Englisch Erfahrung mit DSGVO, ISO 27001 oder dem EU AI Act sind ein Plus Was uns wichtig ist Frameworks kann man lernen. Konkret heißt das: Du entwirfst morgens die Architektur für ein neues Feature, reviewst mittags Pull Requests, entwickelst nachmittags selbst und bringst dabei unser Team fachlich weiter. Wer lieber Tickets abarbeitet und auf Anforderungen wartet, wird bei uns nicht glücklich. Das bekommst Du Start & Welcoming so wie du es verdienst! Ein strukturiertes Onboarding mit echten Ansprechpersonen - damit du vom ersten Tag an durchstartest. raw.title: Senior Salesforce Developer (m/f/d) German speaking
raw.description:
Why we are looking for support

We are seeking an experienced Senior Salesforce Developer to join our team in Germany. 

You’ll be part of a delivery team working across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, B2B Commerce, and Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud. While you don’t need prior experience with Consumer Goods Cloud, you’ll be expected to learn and work with it as part of our core solution landscape.

This is a German-speaking position. Professional fluency in German and English is required, as you will work directly with German-speaking clients and international project teams.

To give you more insights of your working environment, on the organization level you will work on a regular basis in a team of 5-10 developers to gather ideas & improve already existing processes. On a project level you will work in an agile project team of 4-7 people, depending on the project size, to deliver projects to our clients.
What you will find with us: 

  • Real-world Salesforce projects that go beyond textbook use cases
  • A team that values thoughtful engineering, scalable delivery, and ownership
  • Opportunities to learn Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud in live client environments
  • Clear growth paths toward technical lead, solution architect, or industry specialist roles


Your tasks

  • Lead the development, and deployment of Salesforce solutions using different Cloud solutions.
  • Develop end-to-end Salesforce solutions using both configuration and customization
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements, analyze business processes, and deliver scalable solutions
  • Develop Salesforce components using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), and Flows
  • Work closely with solution architects and functional consultants to build scalable solutions across Sales, Service, Commerce, and Consumer Goods Cloud
  • Integrate Salesforce with external systems using APIs and middleware tools (e.g. MuleSoft, SAP CPI)
  • Participate in code reviews, testing, and quality assurance
  • Contribute to DevOps automation using Git, Gearset, or DevOps Center
  • Suggest improvements to performance, reusability, or developer experience
  • Support defect resolution, enhancements, and roll-out activities
  • Stay up-to-date on the latest Salesforce innovations and contribute to internal initiatives and team growth.


Requirements

  • 3–7+ years of hands-on Salesforce development experience
  • Strong skills in Apex, LWC, SOQL/SOSL, and Flow
  • Experience working across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, or Commerce implementations
  • Understanding of integration design, platform limits, and test automation
  • Familiarity with Git-based version control and CI/CD tooling
  • Experience working in structured project teams or consulting environments
  • Interest in learning Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud and applying it in real-world programs
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to debug complex technical issues.
  • Fluent in English and German - other languages are a plus.
  • Demonstrated drive to improve how things are done—whether in performance, automation, or usability
  • The ability to collaborate across technical and functional teams
  • A mindset geared toward learning and adapting in enterprise-scale environments


Nice to Have

  • Salesforce certifications (Platform Developer I/II, JavaScript Developer I, Integration Architecture Designer)
  • Experience with Experience Cloud, CPQ, or Consumer Goods Cloud
  • Background working with or delivering for consumer goods or retail clients
  • Familiarity with agile delivery tools like JIRA, Confluence, and TestRail
  • Experience working with XML based design contracts and Cordova mobile framework

Dann suchen wir dich als Senior Social Media & Video Editor (m/w/d) für unser adfriends-Team!


Deine Aufgaben

  • Du entwickelst Social-Media-Formate und Redaktionskonzepte entlang von Markenstrategie, Zielgruppen und Plattformlogiken und übernimmst die Redaktionsplanung inkl. Posting
  • Du berätst unsere Kunden bei der strategischen Weiterentwicklung ihrer Social Accounts und bringst eigene Ideen und Impulse ein

  • Du übernimmst den redaktionellen Schnitt in Adobe Premiere, entwickelst aus Rohmaterial plattformgerechte Social Assets und koordinierst externe sowie interne Cutter in der Postproduktion
  • Du textest Captions, Hooks und Social Copy für Organic Content sowie Texte und Headlines für Kampagnen und andere Kommunikationsformate


Dein Profil

  • Du bringst mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Bereich Social Media, Redaktion, Content oder Video mit – idealerweise auf Agentur- oder Produktionsseite
  • Du denkst strategisch und redaktionell, kannst aber genauso gut selbst ins Tool gehen und Content umsetzen
  • Ein sehr gutes Gespür für Social Trends, Plattformlogiken und relevante Formate zeichnet dich aus
  • Deine Kenntnisse in Adobe Premiere sind sehr gut - weitere Adobe-Programme sind ein Plus
  • Du hast Erfahrung in der redaktionellen Drehvorbereitung und Drehbegleitung
  • Du hast ein sicheres Gespür für Sprache, Storytelling und unterschiedliche Brand Tonalities
  • Beratungskompetenz zeichnet dich aus: Du kannst Kunden gegenüber souverän auftreten, beraten und deine Empfehlungen argumentieren
  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, eigenständig und zuverlässig und behältst auch bei mehreren Kunden und Produktionen den Überblick

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse runden dein Profil ab


Deine Benefits

  • Friend ist Programm: Wir nennen es zuerst, denn das macht uns aus: Kolleg:innen, die sich Freunde nennen, füreinander einstehen und mit denen es Spaß macht zu arbeiten
  • Volle Flexibilität: Bei uns entscheidest du über Arbeitszeit und Arbeitsort – Hybrid-Work und Homeoffice? Wie es für dich gerade am besten passt!
  • Zukunftsorientiertes Arbeiten: Wir arbeiten am Puls der Zeit und setzen aktiv auf KI in unserem Leistungsportfolio
  • JobRad-Leasing: Ob für den Arbeitsweg oder die Wochenendtour – bei uns kannst du dein Wunschrad ganz einfach leasen
  • Mobilität nach Wahl: Wir unterstützen dich bei deinem Arbeitsweg mit einem Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket und der Option auf einen Tankgutschein 
  • Work-Life-Balance: Schätzen wir genau wie Du und ist mit unserem flexiblen Arbeitsmodell gesichert.
  • Urlaubstage: 28 + 2 * 0,5 freie Tage für Weihnachten und Silvester
  • After-Work-Programm: Neben der Urban-Sports-Mitgliedschaft und regelmäßigen Team-Events erwartet dich unsere jährliche Workation
  • Weiterentwicklung: Wir bieten spannende Projekte und stetige Weiterentwicklung in einer Organisationskultur, in der der Status Quo auch hinterfragt werden darf
  • Drinks & Snacks: In unseren Büros findest du alles für dein Wohlbefinden – Kaffee, Limonade, Bier, frisches Obst und vieles mehr

title: Bookkeeper
description: Bookkeeper — Lab54 Location: London. All 3 days in office for the first three months. From month 4, 1 day per week remote once the agreed targets are being met. Shape: Part-time, 3 days per week. Permanent or contract — both considered. Salary: £30–34k FTE equivalent, pro-rata (£18–20.5k at 3 days). Contract equivalent £150–200 per day. Reports to: Financial Controller (interim: Managing Director) Start: As soon as available About Lab54 Lab54 is a content-led events and production company: [Anywhere But A Club.] We create high-impact experiences in unexpected locations, capture them, and turn them into content. Combined global audience of 425,000+. We work with brands, record labels and artists — around 100 events a year across brand activations, artist pop-ups, hard-ticket shows, house parties and festival takeovers. The role The Bookkeeper is Lab54's day-to-day finance function: reconciliation, purchase-order matching, receipt capture, invoicing, debtor chasing and payroll preparation. The defining feature of the job is that every pound has to land against an event. Lab54's core financial object isn't the month — it's the project. Each event carries a code (YYMM-Owner-Event-City) that runs from HubSpot through Xero, Teamwork and the purchase-order flow. Coding transactions to that project is not admin; it's the thing that makes per-event profitability computable. It is the single most important part of this role. This role prepares, never approves. All payment runs are approved by the Managing Director, with the CEO approving above an agreed threshold. Responsibilities Purchase orders and supplier ledger Match supplier invoices to their purchase order in Xero. This is a manual link, and it is the control that stops us paying more than we agreed. Enforce the PO rule at the front door: any commitment of £500 or more needs a PO, and an invoice arriving without a PO number goes back to the supplier rather than into the ledger. Reconcile supplier statements monthly against our purchase ledger — the check that catches duplicate invoices and payments before they're made. Maintain the purchase ledger and keep the aged creditor position accurate. Reconciliation and coding Bank and card reconciliations kept current within 48 hours, including Revolut Business card spend against Xero tracking categories. Every reconciled line matched to a real source document. A line that reconciles without a bill behind it is an exception to raise, not a box to tick. Code every transaction to the correct project code and tracking category. Chase the team when a code is missing rather than guessing one. Keep the suspense and uncoded accounts at nil by month-end. Produce a weekly untagged-spend report, by spender, and drive it to zero. Receipts and VAT recovery Chase and capture missing receipts to a 98% target. This is a cash exercise, not a filing one — every missing VAT invoice is input VAT we can't reclaim. Flag transactions carrying no VAT treatment where the supplier is UK VAT-registered. Prepare the VAT return workings for the external accountancy firm, who own submission. Sales invoicing and debtors Raise client invoices within 48 hours of the billing trigger, coded to the project. Run a consistent debtor-chasing cycle and maintain the aged debtor position. Match incoming receipts to the right invoice and contact. Money that arrives against the wrong customer looks identical to money that never arrived. Keep sales invoice sequencing clean — anything voided or reissued carries a recorded reason. Payroll preparation Prepare payroll data and submit it to the external payroll provider ahead of deadline. Post the payroll journal to Xero each month. Wages must not sit in a control account. Confirm the payroll account is funded before each run. This role does not execute payroll. Close, deadlines and records Run the monthly close to a published working-day deadline: accruals prepared with supporting detail, journals posted, period locked. Every accrual carries a schedule — supplier, event, date of work. No balance we can't explain. Maintain the statutory deadline register (VAT, PAYE, corporation tax, Companies House) and flag each one in advance. No filing sits invisibly in someone else's workflow. Keep records orderly and audit-ready for the external accountancy firm. What the first 90 days actually look like We are being straight about this because we want someone who finds it interesting rather than alarming. Lab54 has grown faster than its finance function, and we've recently changed accountants. The ledger carries a real backlog: untagged transactions across two financial years, unposted payroll journals, a month-end close that has not been run to a cadence, and a purchase-order process that has only just gone live. There is a documented correction schedule and an external FD working through it. The first 90 days is a clean-up, not a steady state. Days 1–30. Learn the ledger and the project-code structure. Take over reconciliation, receipt capture and PO matching. Get the weekly untagged report running. Days 31–60. Clear the untagged backlog. Take over sales invoicing, debtor chasing and received-payment matching. Payroll preparation and the monthly payroll journal move across. Days 61–90. Run a full month close to deadline: suspense at nil, every accrual scheduled, supplier statements reconciled. Per-project cost data becomes reportable for the first time. After that it becomes a genuinely well-defined job inside a documented control structure — and you'll have built it. On being in the office. The first three months are fully office-based, and that's deliberate rather than a policy position. Clearing a backlog this size means asking people questions in real time — whose card that was, what the missing PO covers, which event a supplier belongs to. That's an hour of work in a room and a week of work over email. From month 4, one of the three days moves to remote, provided the measures below are being met. What we're looking for Essential Proven bookkeeping experience. Xero to a high standard is non-negotiable — tracking categories, purchase orders, bank rules, manual journals. Purchase-order matching and supplier statement reconciliation as routine practice. Strong reconciliation, coding and purchase-ledger discipline. Experience preparing payroll data for an external provider and posting the payroll journal. Comfortable working inside a defined control structure where you prepare and someone else approves. Reliability over ambition. The value of this role is that nothing is ever late or missing. Nice to have Project-costing or job-costing background — agency, events, production, construction, anything where the job is the unit of profit. Multi-currency invoicing and foreign supplier payments. We run events across Europe. Dext, Revolut Business, or similar capture and expense tooling. Experience cleaning up a ledger rather than only maintaining a tidy one. How you'll work Meticulous. Proactive on receipts, POs and debtors — chasing people is part of the job, not an escalation. Willing to say when something doesn't look right. A number you can't explain is a question, not a rounding difference. Discreet and trustworthy with company finances. Organised to deadline without being chased yourself. How we'll measure it Bank and card reconciliations — current within 48 hours, every week. Receipt capture with correct project coding — 98%. Supplier invoices matched to a PO — 100%, with exceptions escalated same day. Untagged transactions — zero at each week-end. Sales invoices raised from trigger — 95%+ within 48 hours. Month-end close — completed to the published working-day deadline, suspense at nil, every accrual scheduled. Payroll — data submitted, journal posted, account funded ahead of deadline, every cycle. Statutory deadlines — every one flagged in advance. Zero missed. What's different about doing this here Per-event P&L, not just a company ledger. You'll see the margin on a festival takeover.
