title: Software Architect
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.</p></div><p><strong>Lead Software Architect</strong></p> <p>At NICE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.</p> <p><strong>Why this role matters now</strong></p> <p>This role sits at the centre of our AI-led delivery transformation. We are rebuilding our digital evidence platform as AI-Native, with AI tooling acting as a daily partner from design through verification. The right architect is not someone with a long list of AI credentials - AI moves too fast for credentials to mean much. The right architect is someone who already uses AI in their daily work, has formed clear judgement about where it belongs and where it does not, and is curious enough to learn the next tool when their current one is superseded.</p> <p><strong>So, what’s the role all about?</strong></p> <p>We are looking for a talented Architect and Software Developer to join our team. You must:</p> <ul> <li>Be able to communicate effectively, including via email, instant message, phone, and video conferencing tools.</li> <li>Be fierce in your pursuit of product quality.</li> <li>Be an excellent problem solver with an active interest in the latest design and development tools and technologies.</li> <li>Be knowledgeable and enthusiastic about process.</li> <li>Be practically fluent with AI tooling - using Copilot, Claude Code, Codex or equivalent in your daily work, not just experimentally. We will discuss specific examples at interview.</li> <li>Be able to recognize opportunities for optimization and enhancement of process, product architecture and delivery based on the evolutions in AI.</li> <li>Have clear judgement about where AI belongs in a public-safety platform, and where it does not.</li> </ul> <p><strong>How will you make an impact?</strong></p> <p>You will be responsible for:</p> <ul> <li>Owning the architecture, and carrying out design, AI-led implementation and validation in Cloud-based, multi-threaded, multi-server environments -working in our AI-led delivery method where code, tests and decisions are AI-drafted, with you setting intent, orchestrating implementation, and validating outputs.</li> <li>Leading technical decisions on architectural direction using a collaborative, team-based approach.</li> <li>Ensuring the architecture takes into account the concerns of security, scalability, compatibility, maintainability — and the responsible, evidenced use of AI in both build-time and run-time.</li> <li>Performing testing of your work, fixing defects, and helping to resolve customer support cases.</li> <li>Ensuring that the team adheres to the architectural direction and standards.</li> <li>Mentoring and coaching team members in architecture practices, AI-led delivery techniques, and the discipline of validating AI outputs.</li> <li>Liaising with Product Management during planning sessions.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Have you got what it takes?</strong></p> <ul> <li>Solid experience developing applications in C# using Visual Studio/Visual Studio Code.</li> <li>Proven track record of breaking down complex market requirements into secure, scalable and resilient system designs.</li> <li>Experience with multi-tenant cloud solutions.</li> <li>Experience working in collaborative multidisciplinary teams.</li> <li>Experience creating maintainable code and using source control solutions such as DevOps, GIT or similar.</li> <li>Experience of unit testing, code reviews, and other product quality disciplines.</li> <li>Solid understanding of the principles of network security, authentication, and authorization.</li> <li>Experience of working with databases using Entity Framework or similar.</li> <li>Good knowledge of SOLID principles.</li> <li>Experience creating RESTful APIs and ensuring API extensibility.</li> <li>Recent practical experience using AI tooling (Copilot, Claude Code, Codex or equivalent) in your daily work, not just experimentation. Comfortable describing what worked, what did not, and what you decided.</li> <li>Output discipline: you remain accountable for the architecture you are responsible for, whatever helped you produce it.</li> <li>Comfort with probabilistic systems, and clear judgement about when to use AI in a high-trust domain.</li> <li>Learning velocity: able to ramp on a new AI tool or technique in days, not months.</li> </ul> <p><strong>You will have an advantage if you also have:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Security best practice (OWASP top ten)</li> <li>Azure SQL Server</li> <li>DevOps, Pipelines, TeamCity, GitHub</li> <li>Windows services</li> <li>Experience using AI tooling specifically in the architect role - for design review, ADR drafting, threat modelling, contract design, or similar.</li> <li>Familiarity with AI-Native software patterns (agentic workflows, evaluation harnesses, prompt-and-response evaluation, evidence packets).</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we do not require</strong></p> <p>We do not require you to be an AI expert. AI moves too fast for credentials to mean much. We require curiosity, recent practical use, output discipline, and the judgement to ship under accountability.</p> <p><strong>About the interview process</strong></p> <p>The final stage includes a working session using our AI tooling. The aim is to see how you think - how you set intent, validate outputs, and make decisions - not to test memorised knowledge.</p> <p><span data-teams="true"><strong>Requisition ID: </strong>11267<br><strong>Reporting into:&nbsp;</strong>Manager<br><strong>Role Type: </strong>Individual Contributor</span></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><span data-teams="true">#LI-Hybrid&nbsp;</span></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em><strong>About NiCE </strong></em></p> <p><em>NICE Ltd. (NASDAQ: NICE) software products are used by 25,000+ global businesses, including 85 of the Fortune 100 corporations, to deliver extraordinary customer experiences, fight financial crime and ensure public safety. Every day, NiCE software manages more than 120 million customer interactions and monitors 3+ billion financial transactions. </em></p> <p><em>Known as an innovation powerhouse that excels in AI, cloud and digital, NiCE is consistently recognized as the market leader in its domains, with over 8,500 employees across 30+ countries. </em></p> <p><em>NiCE is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, neurotype, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other category protected by law.</em></p> <p>&nbsp;</p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior GTM System Builder
description: <div class="content-intro"><h4><strong>Help make the world more hospitable </strong></h4> <p>The hospitality industry is uniquely human, and it deserves technology that’s just as inspiring as the people behind it. At Mews, we’re transforming the industry with a platform that helps hotels run smarter, move faster and create better guest experiences.</p> <p>You’ll work with smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do. You’ll have autonomy and the trust to make good decisions and move quickly. And you’ll enjoy a real sense of purpose as you see the impact of what we’re building.</p> <p>If you’re motivated by ownership, curiosity and meaningful impact, and are driven to deliver consistent high performance, you’ll feel at home here.</p> <h4><strong>About the role</strong></h4> <p>Let's get into the specifics. It’s impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this:</p></div><p>The commercial team at Mews moves deals through a complex, multi-touch GTM motion. The person in this role owns the systems that make that motion faster, smarter, and less dependent on manual effort — from inbound routing and deal enrichment to Gong-driven coaching intelligence and CPQ automation. This is not a support role for the commercial team. It is an ownership role for the infrastructure they run on.</p> <p>You will join the Growth team to own an assigned domain within the GTM stack end to end: scoping, building, shipping, and running production systems that move ARR. You will work under staff technical direction but make your own architecture and build-vs-buy decisions within your domain. You will manage vendor relationships, define observability standards, and be the person who picks up the phone when something breaks in production.</p> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal"><strong>What you would do</strong></p> <ul class="[li_&amp;]:mb-0 [li_&amp;]:mt-1 [li_&amp;]:gap-1 [&amp;:not(:last-child)_ul]:pb-1 [&amp;:not(:last-child)_ol]:pb-1 list-disc flex flex-col gap-1 pl-8 mb-3 print:block print:space-y-1"> <li>Own the full lifecycle of automation and AI-tooling initiatives within your assigned GTM pod: scoping, building, shipping to production, and iterating based on adoption and KPI data — not just ticket completion</li> <li>Build and ship AI-powered pipelines that permanently remove manual GTM work: deal enrichment, outbound research and routing, Gong-driven coaching signals, forecasting inputs, CPQ automation, and proposal follow-up</li> <li>Design the prompting architecture and agent logic that commercial reps, BDRs, and AEs interact with daily — reliable outputs for non-technical end users, with observability and error handling built in from the start</li> <li>Own operational health of your domain's live systems: first responder when things break, with adoption metrics, error rates, and data quality visibility instrumented before deployment</li> <li>Manage vendor relationships at pod level (Gong, Clay, LeanData, ZoomInfo, depending on assignment): SLAs, incident escalation, business reviews, and periodic build-vs-buy re-decisions</li> <li>Support other engineers through code review, pairing, and coaching on architecture trade-offs — and contribute reusable patterns and integrations that accelerate delivery across pod</li> </ul> <p><strong>AI Fluency Level 4:</strong> In this role, AI is not a productivity layer — it is the product. You will architect and ship LLM-powered agents, enrichment pipelines, and AI-assisted automations that the commercial org depends on. You will make engineering decisions about models, infrastructure, and MCP integrations. You will design prompting systems that non-technical users rely on without ever touching a prompt themselves. The test for everything you build is whether a KPI moved — which means your judgment about where AI is trustworthy and where it needs a human in the loop is part of the work, not an afterthought.</p> <p><em>For more information on AI fluency at Mews, please refer to <a href="https://mews.atlassian.net/wiki/x/XQOskg">AI Fluency at Mews: A Comprehensive Guide for Candidates</a> on Confluence.</em></p> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal"><strong>What you would bring</strong></p> <ul class="[li_&amp;]:mb-0 [li_&amp;]:mt-1 [li_&amp;]:gap-1 [&amp;:not(:last-child)_ul]:pb-1 [&amp;:not(:last-child)_ol]:pb-1 list-disc flex flex-col gap-1 pl-8 mb-3 print:block print:space-y-1"> <li>4 to 6 years delivering production software with measurable commercial impact in a product-driven company (high-growth SaaS, startup, or scale-up)</li> <li>Demonstrated end-to-end ownership with strong autonomy: you have defined the approach, navigated genuine ambiguity, and owned the outcome — not executed tickets</li> <li>Has shipped AI-powered pipelines or agents in a real operational context: enrichment, routing, summarization, or AI-assisted automation — not just prototypes</li> <li>Active practitioner of modern AI development tooling (Claude, Lovable, Cursor, or equivalent) and comfortable working with LLM APIs and MCP integrations — AI Fluency Level 4 or the equivalent hands-on engineering experience</li> <li>Hands-on experience building against Salesforce or equivalent CRM APIs: workflows, event-driven logic, and data integrations across multiple systems</li> <li>Comfortable owning live production systems: incident response, observability, vendor management, and data integrity — draws no hard line between building and running</li> <li>Can translate operational pain into technical requirements and explain technical decisions clearly to non-technical stakeholders</li> </ul> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal"><strong>Nice to have</strong></p> <ul class="[li_&amp;]:mb-0 [li_&amp;]:mt-1 [li_&amp;]:gap-1 [&amp;:not(:last-child)_ul]:pb-1 [&amp;:not(:last-child)_ol]:pb-1 list-disc flex flex-col gap-1 pl-8 mb-3 print:block print:space-y-1"> <li>Experience in or alongside a RevOps or GTM function — understands what commercial reps actually need, not the idealized version</li> <li>Hands-on experience with Gong API, Clay, LeanData, or ZoomInfo integrations</li> <li>Familiarity with Nue/CPQ, Databricks, HubSpot, Hook, or Ada</li> </ul><div We are committed to equal pay practices and prohibit salary history inquiries during our recruitment process.</p> <p>If the location you're applying from wasn't originally advertised for this role, salary range information is available upon request at any point during the application/interview process - your recruiter will be able to help.</p> <h4><strong>What’s in it for you?</strong></h4> <p>Our success is powered by our incredible people, supported by benefits that help them thrive.</p> <h4><strong>Global benefits</strong></h4> <p>No matter where you’re based, you’ll enjoy:</p> <ul> <li>Unlimited paid holiday (yes, really)</li> <li>Participation in our company share program</li> <li>Paid parental leave (6 months fully paid for primary caregivers, 2 months for secondary, available after one year of service)</li> <li>An annual Learning budget of €300 (and more for high performers) to support your development</li> <li>Monthly "EDGE" time to Explore, Develop, Grow, and Elevate yourself</li> <li>A work from anywhere policy with flexibility to work abroad for a few weeks each year</li> <li>Relocation options, available after one year</li> <li>Flexible, hybrid working options</li> <li>A home office setup budget to make your workspace your own and a monthly work-from-home allowance</li> <li>Claude tokens, so you can automate workflows and build smarter, more efficient ways of working</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Local benefits</strong></h4> <p>You'll receive additional benefits that vary by location, from healthcare and retirement plans to team events, socials and other perks. Ask us about it during your interview process.</p> <h4><strong>Life at Mews</strong></h4> <p>We’re an equal opportunities employer. We value teams that reflect the diversity of the customers and communities we serve. Different perspectives make better ideas, stronger products and a more welcoming company.</p> <p>We also believe transparency is important when deciding if you're the right fit. Mews is an ambitious, high-pressure environment of continuous learning and high standards. Success here requires resilience, adaptability and a willingness to solve difficult problems.</p> <p>A few things that define how we work:</p> <ul> <li>High autonomy means high responsibility. People are expected to take ownership and drive outcomes. There isn’t a detailed playbook for everything, and that’s part of what makes the work challenging – and rewarding.</li> <li>Change is constant. We’re growing quickly and adapting as we scale. Teams, processes and priorities continue to evolve, and only people who stay curious and agile will thrive.</li> <li>We’re remote-first, not relationship-free. Flexibility is core to how we work, but strong relationships still matter. Our teams are global, so we need expert collaborators and communicators to help us move forward together.</li> <li>AI is an integral part of our processes. It’s not here to steal people’s jobs, but to amplify efficiency and productivity. We’re motivated to proactively use the technology to seek out better ways of working and share our findings with the rest of the company.</li> </ul> <p>If there's anything we can do to support you during the application process, let us know.</p> <p>We don't discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, nationality, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability or any other protected characteristic.</p> <p>One final thing: don't hold back. If you don't meet 100% of the criteria in this job description but you're certain you could make a big impact, apply. Everyone should have equal access to opportunities, and we're committed to providing an inclusive experience.</p> <p>If Mews sounds like the kind of environment where you'd thrive, we'd love to hear from you.</p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

It’s impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this:</p></div><h3>POSITION OVERVIEW</h3> <p>Product marketing at Mews is at a turning point. The function has been effective at launching products; what it has not yet built is the strategic layer that comes after launch – the continuous positioning, adoption strategy, and market intelligence that makes each product more valuable over time. This role owns that shift.</p> <p>The Director of Product Marketing and Market Research is a combined senior leadership role responsible for two things that should never have been separated: how Mews brings products to market, and how Mews understands the market it operates in. You will lead the product marketing team, own the research and customer insights function, and serve as the go-to authority on both disciplines for senior leadership across the business.</p> <p>Mews operates across property management, fintech and payments, guest experience, and marketplace. The right person for this role knows how to build a coherent positioning story across a complex multi-product portfolio – and how to ground that story in real market intelligence, customer insight, and competitive understanding rather than assumption.</p> <h3>RESPONSIBILITIES</h3> <h3>Product marketing strategy</h3> <ul> <li> <p>Define and own product marketing strategy across the Mews portfolio – covering positioning, messaging, and go-to-market execution from launch through adoption and ongoing engagement.</p> </li> <li> <p>Build and govern the global product launch framework so that launches are scalable and repeatable, with clear handoffs between strategy and execution.</p> </li> <li> <p>Own product adoption and post-launch engagement strategy – moving the function beyond launch execution to continuous market thinking that drives usage, retention, and revenue contribution.</p> </li> <li> <p>Partner with Product, Sales, RevOps, and Customer Success to ensure product marketing strategy connects to commercial outcomes and is reflected in how the business goes to market.</p> </li> <li> <p>Own NPS tracking programs and design the measurement framework for product marketing impact, including product attach rates, adoption metrics, and pipeline contribution.</p> </li> </ul> <h3>Market research and customer insights</h3> <ul> <li> <p>Own the end-to-end market research function: identifying research opportunities, designing methodology, running studies, synthesising findings, and activating insights across the business.</p> </li> <li> <p>Lead primary and secondary research initiatives that inform strategic, commercial, and product decisions – including competitive analysis, customer behaviour, market sizing, and buyer intelligence.</p> </li> <li> <p>Build competitive intelligence as a structured, ongoing discipline – not a one-off project. Translate competitive signals into positioning decisions, sales enablement, and product roadmap input.</p> </li> <li> <p>Serve as the functional authority on what the market is telling Mews, and translate that into insight narratives that influence senior leadership decisions and business strategy.</p> </li> <li> <p>Work closely with Strategy, Product, RevOps, and Marketing to ensure insights land where decisions get made, not just where they get read.</p> </li> </ul> <h3>Team and function leadership</h3> <ul> <li> <p>Lead and develop a team of product marketers, setting clear expectations, building capability, and creating a culture of commercial accountability.</p> </li> <li> <p>Set the operating model for how the team works with AI – determining where AI handles execution tasks and where human judgment is irreplaceable, and building team-level standards accordingly.</p> </li> <li> <p>Serve as the senior leadership go-to on product marketing and market intelligence – the person any executive can trust for a well-grounded, commercially-connected answer.</p> </li> <li> <p>Represent product marketing and research in executive forums, contributing to annual planning and portfolio prioritisation decisions.</p> </li> </ul> <h3>REQUIREMENTS</h3> <h3>Professional knowledge and experience</h3> <ul> <li> <p>10+ years in B2B SaaS marketing, with the majority of that time in product marketing – not demand generation, not agency, not brand-only roles.</p> </li> <li> <p>Has held a Director, Senior Director, or Head of Product Marketing title, or a broader marketing leadership title that included ownership of the product marketing function.</p> </li> <li> <p>Proven track record managing and developing a multi-person product marketing team, including hiring, coaching, and performance management.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience owning or significantly contributing to a market research or customer insights function – primary research methodology, competitive intelligence programs, or voice-of-customer work.</p> </li> <li> <p>Deep understanding of B2B SaaS go-to-market strategy: positioning, messaging architecture, pricing and packaging alignment, sales enablement, and lifecycle marketing.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience building or significantly reshaping a product marketing function – not just managing an inherited one.</p> </li> <li> <p>Has operated in a lean, fast-moving environment such as a scale-up, growth-stage, or pre-IPO company. Experience only in large enterprise environments with unlimited resources is unlikely to be a strong fit.</p> </li> </ul> <h3>Skills and capabilities</h3> <ul> <li> <p>Owns GTM strategy end-to-end – from initial positioning through post-launch adoption and continuous market engagement. Experience limited to launch execution is not sufficient.</p> </li> <li> <p>Connects product marketing directly to revenue outcomes. Can articulate how their work has influenced pipeline, product attach rates, adoption, or retention – not just campaign outputs.</p> </li> <li> <p>Translates research into business decisions – not just insight reports. Has a track record of research that changed a strategic or commercial direction.</p> </li> <li> <p>Multi-functional marketing experience beyond product marketing, for example content, SEO, digital, demand generation, or go-to-market strategy.</p> </li> <li> <p>Metrics-driven. Comfortable defining and owning the measurement framework for both product marketing impact and research quality.</p> </li> <li> <p>Strong senior stakeholder communication. Able to influence executive decisions, present with authority, and earn trust through substance rather than seniority alone.</p> </li> <li> <p>Publicly visible in the product marketing or insights community – speaker, writer, or recognised contributor to the discipline. Not a requirement, but a meaningful differentiator.</p> </li> </ul> <h3>AI fluency</h3> <p>AI is changing the product marketing function in a way that is more structural than any other recent technology shift. A significant part of this role is deciding what that means for the team at Mews – what AI handles, what stays human, and how to build a team that operates at a higher strategic level as execution work is automated.</p> <p>We expect this person to: use AI tools deliberately and with criteria; describe specific examples of AI changing how they or their team works strategically; have a point of view on where the product marketing function is heading as AI matures; and build team-level standards for AI use, including how to review and quality-control AI-assisted outputs before they reach senior stakeholders or customers.</p> <h3>NICE TO HAVE</h3> <ul> <li> <p>Fintech, payments, or financial services product marketing experience.</p> </li> <li> <p>Hospitality, travel tech, or hotel SaaS background.</p> </li> <li> <p>Both fintech and hospitality in one profile is the strongest possible combination for this role.</p> </li> <li> <p>Global market experience.</p> </li> <li>   • Use of a variety of channels to identify new prospects and close new deals such as social media, internet, web-based tools & outbound calling

  • Manage effectively all CRM activity relating to your accounts (Salesforce) and all the tech stack of an AE at Livestorm (SalesNav, Salesloft, Modjo, Chili Piper, Notion & more)

  • Outbound Mindset: You have a desire, even an obsession, to identify new prospects, contacts and decision makers to expand the number of new logos

Moreover, we are looking for someone based in Paris (to meet prospects, go on events and be close to your management) but working remotely anywhere in France is permitted.

Livestorm is the world's leading end-to-end video engagement platform. Founded in 2016, Livestorm allows companies to organize powerful online meetings, webinars and virtual events from end-to-end. Our web-browser platform provides teams with all the workflows around video engagement to promote, host and analyze online events. Livestorm is built with ease of use in mind. We serve companies of all sizes, from startups to Fortune 500s. Brands like Shopify, Honda, Spendesk, Front and Revolut trust Livestorm for premium video engagement during their online events.


Here are our core values:

  • Stay curious: Be interested in the world around you.

  • Remain humble: Keep learning and keep your ego in check.

  • Be resourceful: Go that extra mile in the most efficient way.

  • Own it: Take pride in what you do, own your wins, and fails.

  • Be transparent: Sharing knowledge, learnings, feedback, and mistakes.


MISSION

Livestorm sales team is a team of entrepreneurial and driven sales professionals. They are playing a key role in the expansion of Livestorm as we establish ourselves as a market leader in the video communication market, leveraging Livestorm's existing customer references, marketing programs, turning leads into long-lasting partnerships.


Account Executives are responsible for identifying, segmenting, engaging, and converting qualified Mid-Market and Enterprise prospects into paying customers according to an annual quota.


You will report to the Head of New Business, and will closely collaborate with all our teams (Marketing, Sales, Customer Care, Product and Finance) to drive maximum value and success with new Livestorm customers.


A successful Account Executive will be a skilled communicator and presenter who can find the best fit between client and product.


IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL

  • Qualify inbound marketing source leads (MQLs) coming from Mid-Market & Enterprise prospects and turn them, if qualified, into opportunities and closed contracts

  • Focus your outbound efforts on the Enterprise segment (with a focus on the Finance, Healthcare & Tech industries) and develop / execute sales strategies and tactics to generate pipeline, drive sales opportunities and deliver repeatable and predictable bookings

  • Work on the NEMEA (Nordics & UK) and US market (native speakers are preferred for this role / previous sales experience in these regions is a big plus).

  • Use of a variety of channels to identify new prospects and close new deals such as social media, internet, web-based tools & outbound calling

  • Manage effectively all CRM activity relating to your accounts (Salesforce) and all the tech stack of an AE at Livestorm (SalesNav, Salesloft, Modjo, Chili Piper, Notion & more)

  • Pro-actively work with other teams (Account Management, Growth & Marketing, Customer Success, etc.)

  • Provide clients’ feedback, especially on product, in order for Livestorm to adjust and prioritize its product roadmap.


At Livestorm, we believe that diversity's got talent! We are committed to building an inclusive company culture in which a diverse mix of talented people will feel proud to join and engage. Our goal is to ensure that every Stormie feels valued and has the opportunity to thrive. Ready to apply? We are ready to meet you! All applicants will be considered for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.


JOB REQUIREMENTS 

  • Experienced: You have extensive experience (+3 years minimum) of successfully selling Software/SaaS license agreements into Enterprise / Large accounts in France and abroad across a variety of industries (expertise in the Finance & Healthcare industries is a plus)

  • Industry Knowledge: A good understanding of selling video communication platform would be ideal however, a background in selling SaaS and closing 6/7 figure deals is more important

  • Overachiever: You have consistently achieved and/or exceeded your sales goals across your geographic territory and have a track record in closing 6/7 figure contracts - You are results oriented

  • Outbound Mindset: You have a desire, even an obsession, to identify new prospects, contacts and decision makers to expand the number of new logos

  • Excellent Communication: You know what to say (both internally and with clients) and more importantly, how to say it in both French and English

  • Collaborator: You know that selling is a team sport and will partner with virtual teams to ensure success. You have experience in working with remote teams and clients to close joint business

  • Go-Getter: Willing to go the extra mile with a strong work ethic - disciplined and resourceful.


Moreover, we are looking for someone based in Paris (to meet prospects, go on events and be close to your management) but working remotely anywhere in France is permitted.


Confidence can sometimes hold us back from applying for a job. But we'll let you in on a secret: there's no such thing as a 'perfect' candidate. So however you identify and whatever background you bring with you, please apply if this is a role that would make you excited to come into work every day.

WHY THIS ROLE IS DIFFERENT

  • Direct line to the top. You'll work shoulder-to-shoulder with the CEO and sit in the room for every major decision, no layers, no filters.
  • Real scope, real ownership. This isn't a coordination-only or admin-only role. You'll own the board rhythm, shape internal reporting, and run special projects end-to-end.
  • A bridge between two worlds. You'll be the connective tissue between a lean European startup and a US shareholder, a rare vantage point most operators only get years into their career.
  • Impact you can see. With ~20 people, your work doesn't get lost in a hierarchy. What you fix, ships. What you build, gets used.

  • Board & shareholder rhythm Own the full cadence with our shareholders:  board decks, pre-reads, action tracking, and follow-through, so nothing slips between meetings
  • Leadership operating system Run the agenda, follow-ups, and accountability loop for leadership meetings. The person who makes sure decisions turn into action, not just notes.
  • Reporting & analytics Build and maintain pipeline dashboards (HubSpot), KPI tracking, and management/investor reporting that leadership actually relies on.
  • CEO partnership Support the CEO on communications, meeting prep, and represent them in operational forums when needed.
  • Special projects Lead cross-functional initiative:  process improvements, tool rollouts, scaling projects with real autonomy to design and execute.

Requirements

  • 3–5 years in business operations, strategy consulting, or a Chief of Staff–type role, SaaS or logistics/supply chain experience is a strong plus
  • A builder's mindset: organized, detail-obsessed, and allergic to dropped balls
  • Comfort with data: HubSpot, spreadsheets, dashboards, and slide decks are your natural habitat
  • Fluent French and English, written and spoken

  • Startup energy,  you're energized by ambiguity, not slowed by it

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience working with US shareholders or inside a subsidiary structure
  • Familiarity with Notion, PandaDoc, Basecamp, or HubSpot
  • A genuine interest in sustainability, logistics, or the maritime industry
  • Experience helping a company professionalize through a scaling phase

Benefits

  • A high-impact seat at the leadership table, from day one
  • Exposure to both European startup culture and US corporate governance
  • A fast-paced, no-BS environment; your work matters immediately, not eventually
  • Competitive fixed salary + performance bonus
  • Mutuelle, and standard French benefits (Syntec collective agreement)
  • Two company-wide offsites a year
  • A mission worth showing up for: helping decarbonize global trade

d’ordres et les opérationnels pour s’assurer de l’adéquation de la prestation avec le besoin, et identifier des opportunités de suite ou d’extension de la mission,</li> <li>Contribue au thought leadership de VML Consulting sur les enjeux B2B et énergie (transition énergétique, décarbonation, expérience client B2B, data), via des prises de parole valorisant nos convictions et nos réussites dans une logique de ROI business,</li> <li>Construit et fait vivre un patrimoine de connaissances sur les marchés B2B et le secteur de l’énergie (acteurs, enjeux réglementaires, dynamiques de marché) afin d’accélérer et de fluidifier l’action commerciale,</li> <li>Incarne, diffuse et fait vivre l’excellence commerciale en interne, en particulier auprès de la communauté managériale pour l’inspirer, la faire progresser et développer ses appétences et son niveau d’impact business.</li> </ul> <p><em>Dimension Conseil :</em></p> <ul> <li>Réalise, seul ou en équipe, des missions de conseil sur les sujets B2B et énergie, afin de maintenir un haut niveau de crédibilité et de légitimité dans la dimension Business,</li> <li>Pilote des missions de conseil, sur l’ensemble des composantes&nbsp;: qualité des livrables, respects des plannings et des engagements, tenue de l’équilibre budgétaire,</li> <li>Fait évoluer son savoir-faire et ses connaissances via une veille continue sur les sujets qui comptent pour nos clients et prospects, mais aussi des formations et sa curiosité,</li> <li>Maîtrise et met en œuvre toute la chaîne de production d’une mission de la prise de commande au recouvrement, pour assurer performance opérationnelle complète,</li> <li>Manage des équipes pluridisciplinaires de consultants dans le cadre des missions, et assure une coordination et une information continue de sa hiérarchie pour permettre un feedback constructif et le développement des compétences,</li> <li>Garantit la capitalisation du savoir et des livrables sur ses missions, et partage des retours d’expérience autant que de besoin.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Profil recherché</strong></p> <p>Vous justifiez de 7 à 15 ans d’expérience, dont un parcours significatif en cabinet de conseil (stratégie, transformation ou conseil opérationnel). Une expérience des marchés B2B et/ou du secteur de l’énergie (énergéticiens, utilities, transition énergétique) est un atout déterminant.</p> <p>Notre métier consistant à vendre et réaliser des missions mobilisant une grande diversité de compétences (data, conseil, créatif, technologique), vous avez développé une véritable appétence pour la vente “architecte” : savoir lire des enjeux clients transverses et y répondre en mobilisant des équipes pluridisciplinaires.</p> <p>Vous pouvez justifier de contributions ou de succès significatifs dans le cadre d’initiatives business, au-delà d’en comprendre la logique ou les bonnes pratiques.</p> <p>Votre capacité à nouer des relations de grande qualité avec des décideurs – Directions Générales, Directions Commerciales et B2B, Directions Marketing, Directions de la Transition Énergétique, Directions des Opérations ou DSI – fait de vous un acteur à l’aise et performant, de la découverte du besoin à la conclusion d’un deal équilibrant les intérêts du client et de VML Consulting.</p> <p>Les enjeux des marchés B2B et du secteur de l’énergie vous passionnent, et vous savez vous appuyer sur vos expériences pour bâtir un discours solide en avant-vente comme en mission.</p> <p>Votre rigueur et votre curiosité font de vous un acteur à la fois à l’aise dans la logique de développement business sur des clients existants que sur de la conquête opportuniste, ou en relai d’un partenaire.</p> <p>La maîtrise de l’anglais, à l’oral comme à l’écrit, est indispensable : vous adressez des clients et des interlocuteurs internationaux de manière totalement autonome.</p> <p><strong>Tous nos postes sont ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap.</strong></p> <p><strong>Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?</strong></p> <p>Intégrer VML Consulting, c’est choisir d’évoluer dans un environnement dynamique, humain et innovant, propice au développement de chacun, à la réalisation de missions enrichissantes et aux évolutions de carrière. Nous rejoindre, c’est participer à une aventure collective au service de l’épanouissement personnel.</p> <p>Nous menons à bien notre projet d’entreprise sans sacrifier nos valeurs :</p> <ul> <li>Un positionnement clair</li> <li>Le respect de chacun</li> <li>L’engagement auprès de nos clients</li> <li>L’épanouissement professionnel et l’entente entre collaborateurs</li> </ul> <p>Vous partagez ces valeurs, rejoignez-nous !</p> <p>#LI-EMEA</p> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span class="normaltextrun"><span lang="EN-GB"><span lang="EN-GB">We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. Our mission is to architect AI that learns from and interacts with the world like humans do.

We're pioneering the model architectures that will make this possible. Our founding team met as PhDs at the Stanford AI Lab, where we invented State Space Models or SSMs, a new primitive for training efficient, large-scale foundation models. Our team combines deep expertise in model innovation and systems engineering paired with a design-minded product engineering team to build and ship cutting edge models and experiences.

We're funded by leading investors at Index Ventures and Lightspeed Venture Partners, along with Factory, Conviction, A Star, General Catalyst, SV Angel, Databricks and others. We're fortunate to have the support of many amazing advisors, and 90+ angels across many industries, including the world's foremost experts in AI.

Overview

We are seeking native-level French speakers with a linguistics background to serve as the primary language resource for voice AI in their language. You will be the trusted point of contact for all questions, quality decisions, and language-specific work related to French.

This is not a standard annotation engagement. You will own your language end to end, which includes managing annotation quality, auditing data, monitoring product performance, investigating customer-reported issues, and executing projects that require deep linguistic expertise and attention to detail. You will operate independently across these workstreams and serve as the team's go-to resource for anything related to your language.

This is an ongoing contractor engagement. Availability during some US Pacific business hours is preferred to allow for team syncs and real-time support.

 

About the Engagement

You will coordinate with the Human Evals Manager on project deliverables and timelines. Some examples of what your day-to-day work may include:

  • Answer questions from annotators about guidelines, edge cases, or language-specific issues via an agreed project communication channel.

  • Cascade new feedback, instructions, or rubric updates to annotators working on your projects.

  • Listen to annotator-rated audio files and check whether their ratings and written feedback align with the rubric.

  • Prepare written quality assessments for annotators with specific examples and recommendations.

  • Listen to TTS output and provide ground truth assessments of pronunciation, prosody, and naturalness in your language.

  • Update or expand sections of the annotation guidelines when you find gaps or edge cases.

  • Prep and run calibration meetings with annotators.

  • Hold office hours on a mutually agreed schedule during active studies so annotators can ask questions in real time.

  • Develop onboarding materials and resources for new annotators.

  • Write QA reports on annotation quality and calibration outcomes.

  • Review production audio in your language and flag quality issues to the team.

  • Investigate language-specific issues reported by customers and identify root causes.

  • Audit datasets for linguistic accuracy, completeness, and consistency.

     

Commitment

Roughly 40 hours per week with flexibility in scheduling. Project hours may vary depending on active studies, data projects, and product needs. Participation in periodic coordination meetings during US Pacific hours is expected.

 

Requirements

  • Native-level proficiency in French as spoken in France.

  • Experience with data annotation, transcription, or language quality assurance.

  • Strong foundation in linguistics or a related field, with the ability to apply concepts like phonetics, prosody, and intonation when evaluating speech and writing annotation guidelines.

  • Strong written English proficiency. All guidelines, feedback, reports, and team communication are in English.

  • Ability to write clear, structured instructions and deliver specific, actionable feedback to annotators.

  • Comfortable working with data and metrics such as inter-rater agreement scores, audit spreadsheets, and structured feedback templates.

  • Self-directed and able to manage feedback cycles, QA reviews, and data projects without close oversight.

Preferred

  • Experience writing or maintaining annotation guidelines or rubrics.

  • Experience training, mentoring, or managing other annotators.

  • Experience with audio evaluation, TTS, or STT.

  • Conversational spoken English proficiency for meetings and calibration syncs.

  • Experience working with distributed, remote teams.


This is a 1099 contract opportunity and will not be eligible for the benefits below. Language Leads work on an ongoing basis, renewable by mutual agreement. You will control your own methods for completing assigned work, supply your own equipment, and are responsible for your own taxes. You must be authorized to work in your country of residence.

 

Note: Cartesia participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with Form I-9 information to confirm employment eligibility after hire.

More Details

🏢 In-office policy: We’re an in-person team based out of offices in 🇺🇸 San Francisco, 🇬🇧 London and 🇮🇳 Bangalore. We love being in the office, hanging out together, and learning from each other every day.

🌎 Visa sponsorship: We provide visa sponsorship support and assess each circumstance on a case-by-case basis. However, visa sponsorship is dependent on many factors, including the role you are applying for, and the location you are going to be based, and so we can't always guarantee success. Your Recruiter will work with you to understand your visa sponsorship needs from the first call.

🚢 We ship fast. All of our work is novel and cutting edge, and execution speed is paramount. We have a high bar, and we don’t sacrifice quality or design along the way.

🤝 We support each other. We have an open & inclusive culture that’s focused on giving everyone the resources they need to succeed.

Our Benefits (US Employees Only)

💰 Compensation Competitive base salary alongside attractive equity package.

🩺 Health Insurance Fully covered medical insurance along with dental and vision for you and your family.

🧑‍🧑‍🧒‍🧒 Parental Leave 9 weeks paternity & 12 weeks maternity leave

🏦 401(k)

🚆 Commuter Allowance A monthly stipend to help you get to and from the office.

🏖️ Flexible PTO Take as much time as you need to recharge your batteries.

🍲 Meals & Snacks Lunch, dinner and plenty of snacks, provided daily.

🦖 Your own personal Yoshi

Cartesia is an equal opportunity employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other legally protected status.

title: Senior Social Media Manager - France
description: Why Deliveroo Our mission is to transform the way you shop and eat, bringing the neighbourhood to your door by connecting consumers, restaurants, shops and riders. We are transforming the way the world eats and shops by making access to food and products more convenient and enjoyable. We give people the opportunity to buy what they want, as they want it, when and where they want it. We are a technology-driven company at the forefront of the most rapidly expanding industry in the world. We are still a small team, making a very large impact, and looking to answer some of the most interesting questions out there. We move fast, value autonomy and ownership, and we are always looking for new ideas. Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Brand & Experience team builds the emotional connection between Deliveroo and our customers, riders, and partners. With a deep understanding of our audience and a passion for creativity, we bring our brand to life across every touchpoint. Whether it’s a push notification, social campaign, or packaging design, we craft compelling experiences that shape perceptions, spark engagement, and make Deliveroo a loved, global brand. We’re looking for a Senior Manager, Social Media - France to lead the strategy, planning and delivery of Deliveroo’s French social presence. You’ll shape how Deliveroo shows up across social channels, ensuring our work is culturally relevant, platform-native, creatively ambitious and connected to our wider marketing and business strategy. Sitting within our Global Brand Marketing function and reporting to the Director, Social, Cultural and Earned Media, you’ll work closely with our France Marketing team, agency partners and colleagues across Brand, Media, Integrated Marketing, Consumer Communications, Commercial, Grocery and Retail. This role is open to applicants based in France or England and follows a hybrid working model, with three days a week in either our Paris or London HQ . What You’ll Be Doing You’ll be joining our Social, Culture and Earned Media team, connecting people with Deliveroo through the moments, partnerships and experiences that matter most. You’ll balance strategic ownership with hands-on leadership, setting the long-term direction for social in France while ensuring our day-to-day presence is timely, engaging and effective. Here’s what your day-to-day might look like: Set the direction for social in France , leading our strategy and roadmap across always-on activity, brand campaigns, commercial priorities, cultural moments and reactive opportunities, with a focus on building brand equity, consideration and cultural relevance. Turn global thinking into locally relevant work , translating brand and campaign strategies into social-first ideas, formats and executions that resonate with French audiences and feel native to each platform. Lead our French social presence , overseeing channels including Instagram, TikTok, Facebook and YouTube, as well as the content calendar, tone of voice and community engagement approach. Bring teams and partners together , acting as the senior social lead for France and collaborating across local Marketing, Brand, Media, Commercial, PR, Global and European Social teams to embed social early in campaign planning and share learnings across markets. Lead creative delivery and partnerships , managing agency partners and influencer activity from briefing and production through approvals and launch, ensuring work meets the right creative, strategic and operational standards. Keep Deliveroo connected to culture , monitoring French culture, creators, communities, trends, platform behaviours and competitors to identify credible opportunities for Deliveroo to join or lead conversations. Turn performance into progress , establishing effective ways of working, reporting on social performance and community insights, and using those learnings to optimise content, campaigns and channel strategy. You’ll also coach junior team members and contribute to raising social standards across markets. What You’ll Need to Thrive Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others: Deep social and cultural expertise , with strong knowledge of major platforms including Instagram, TikTok, Facebook and YouTube, alongside an excellent understanding of French culture, internet behaviour, creators, communities and trends. Flawless written French and excellent English communication skills , with the judgement to develop distinctive, accurate and culturally relevant brand communications. Strong strategic and creative judgement , with experience developing social strategies and campaigns that build brand visibility, engagement and cultural relevance, from initial strategy and briefing through execution, optimisation and reporting. A data-informed approach , with a strong understanding of social metrics and the ability to translate performance and community insights into clear recommendations that improve future work. Strong leadership and collaboration skills , with experience managing agency partners, creative development, stakeholders and competing priorities, alongside the ability to coach junior colleagues, influence effectively and operate autonomously in a fast-moving environment. Why Join Us? We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community organisers, proud parents, and more. All energised with an entrepreneurial, relentless spirit which helps us do big things as a team. 🔧 High autonomy to build and deliver impactful work 🌱 Support to learn and grow , from L&D programmes to mentoring 💚 Wellbeing matters , with resources and benefits designed to support our people 🌍 A place to belong , with a global workforce and active employee communities Our benefits differ by country and include support across areas such as healthcare, wellbeing, parental leave, pensions and generous annual leave allowances, including time off to support a charitable cause of your choice. Your recruiter can tell you more about the benefits available in your location. The Interview Process We aim to create a fair process that gives you the opportunity to show us your experience, thinking and approach. The process will typically include conversations with our recruitment team and key stakeholders across Brand Marketing, giving you the chance to learn more about the role and team while we explore your social media expertise, strategic thinking, creative judgement, leadership and collaboration style.   • nxAccess : un moteur d’exécution complet intégrant un environnement algorithmique FPGA permettant aux utilisateurs de précharger des ordres directement dans le matériel, de recevoir les données de marché, de déclencher et mettre à jour ces ordres, puis de les transmettre à la place de négociation, en combinant la vitesse et les performances du matériel avec la flexibilité du logiciel

Vous travaillerez au sein d’une équipe composée d’ingénieurs logiciel et matériel, pilotée par un Engineering Manager en étroite collaboration avec le Product Owner de l’équipe.

  • Capacité à évaluer la qualité et les performances d’une architecture donnée

  • Environnement technique : VHDL, Linux, Python, réseaux, Jenkins, Git

  • Maîtrise professionnelle du français et de l’anglais

Axle has quickly become the leader in our operational markets, and we’re now looking to expand our reach in France.

At the core of our market expansion plans is market analysis. To maximise future revenue, we spend a lot of time understanding the value of flexibility in power markets around the world.

We are looking for a technical individual (data scientist, analyst or engineer) with strong knowledge of the French electricity markets and an instinct for commercial value.

You will become Axle’s internal expert on French power markets: understanding the market rules, modelling the value, and building relationships with system operators and regulators. We’re scrappy about method and rigorous about conclusions.

  • Developing a deep understanding of French energy markets and grid dynamics to understand how trading, compensation, penalties and cash flow work

  • Building and optimising models of wholesale/NEBCO, capacity, balancing, ancillary services and local flexibility markets in France to forecast what different assets can earn

  • Sizing the revenue opportunity across markets and products to shape where we expand next

  • Building and evaluating different strategies for cycling a battery or load-shifting an EV charger

  • Monitoring and shaping energy regulation to accelerate the growth of flexibility.

About us White Circle is an AI Safety company building the safety, reliability, and optimization layer for AI systems. At the core of our platform are policies – simple natural-language rules that define what an AI model should and shouldn’t do. We automatically test, enforce, and continuously improve these policies at scale. We’ve raised $11M from top funds, founders, and senior leaders at OpenAI, Anthropic, HuggingFace, Mistral, DeepMind, Datadog, Sentry, and others We process over 100M+ API calls every month We fine-tune and train our own LLMs so they run faster and cheaper than any open or proprietary model We’re a small, highly focused team. If you want to work deeply on hard problems, see your work ship to production quickly, and influence how AI safety is actually built – you’re the one we need. About the team White Circle's fundamental research team works on the science of how AI systems fail: where agents break, why misalignment and unsafe behaviours emerge, and how to catch them before they reach the real world. We build the evals, benchmarks, environments, and tooling that empirically study the most pressing AI safety concerns — some of which become the guardrails shipped in our products, and some of which become public writeups. You will Build adversarial environments for agents: complex, uncertain settings that sit on the boundary of agent capability and alignment, where failure is informative rather than trivial. Build realistic multi-agent environments and instrument them so emergent breakdowns are observable — failures that arise from the agents themselves, not ones scripted from the outside. Run experiments end to end, against external APIs and our own models, orchestrating many agents in parallel. Catalogue concrete agent failure modes and build the tooling to surface them at scale. Turn findings into internal models of agent behaviour and into public writeups. You’ll fit right in if you: Have built at least one non-trivial agent environment or automated research pipeline that ran end to end (single- or multi-agent), and can talk through what broke and why. Strong software and AI engineering. Can independently orchestrate many agents and containers in parallel without that orchestration being the bottleneck.   • You have strong fundamentals in system design – you can reason about trade-offs, failure modes, and scaling.

raw.title: Multimodal ML Engineer
raw.description:
TLDR: Multimodal ML Engineer to train and ship vision, audio, video, and speech models for an AI safety platform that operates at 100M+ API calls/month.

About us

White Circle is an AI Safety company building the safety, reliability, and optimization layer for AI systems. At the core of our platform are policies – simple natural-language rules that define what an AI model should and shouldn’t do. We automatically test, enforce, and continuously improve these policies at scale.

  • We’ve raised $11M from top funds, founders, and senior leaders at OpenAI, Anthropic, HuggingFace, Mistral, DeepMind, Datadog, Sentry, and others

  • We process over 100M+ API calls every month

  • We fine-tune and train our own LLMs so they run faster and cheaper than any open or proprietary model

We’re a small, highly focused team. If you want to work deeply on hard problems, see your work ship to production quickly, and influence how AI safety is actually built – you’re the one we need.

You will

  • Train and fine-tune large-scale multimodal models (vision-language, audio, speech) from scratch and from pretrained checkpoints

  • Extend models across modalities: image understanding, video temporal modeling, long-context processing, and streaming audio

  • Design and run experiments: architecture changes, data mixes, training recipes

  • Build and maintain multimodal data pipelines — from raw images, video, and audio recordings to training-ready datasets, including synthetic data generation

  • Train and optimize MoE architectures for efficient multimodal inference

  • Build alignment pipelines: SFT, DPO, GRPO, reward modeling — across modalities, not just text

  • Optimize models for production: quantization, distillation, batching, streaming and low-latency serving

  • Deploy models end-to-end: from research checkpoint to production serving

  • Define evaluation metrics and benchmarks that actually matter for the product: visual QA, spatial reasoning, video comprehension, speech and audio understanding

You’ll fit right in if you

  • 3+ years training large-scale deep learning models in multimodal domains (vision-language, audio, speech, or acoustic)

  • Strong PyTorch skills with hands-on distributed training experience (DeepSpeed, FSDP, or similar)

  • Deep experience with multimodal architectures — you understand how vision/audio encoders, projectors, and LLMs fit together (LLaVA, Qwen-VL, InternVL, Audio Flamingo, Omni Qwen, Audio Qwen, Whisper, HuBERT, Conformer, or similar)

  • Hands-on with RLHF/alignment for multimodal: GRPO, DPO, reward modeling — not just for text

  • Experience with video and/or audio sequence modeling: temporal modeling, long-context processing, efficient attention, streaming inference

  • Track record of shipping models to production: you've hit latency targets and optimized inference, not just reported benchmark scores

  • Comfortable with large-scale multimodal dataset curation: image-text pairs, video-instruction data, audio preprocessing, augmentation, synthetic data generation

  • Familiar with MoE architectures and their tradeoffs for multimodal workloads

  • Strong engineering fundamentals: clean code, version control, testing, documentation

A big plus:

  • Understanding of audio signal processing fundamentals (spectrograms, mel features, noise reduction)

Why White Circle

  • Paid time off in line with your local regulations, no matter where you work from

  • Work from Paris (hybrid) with a relocation package available, or work from London (note: we are unable to provide relocation support for London-based roles)

  • Comprehensive medical insurance for our France-based team (please note that we are in the process of setting up our UK office and therefore cannot offer medical insurance for London-based roles yet)

  • Meaningful equity package

  • All the hardware, tools, and services you need

  • Covered subscriptions for AI agents and IDEs

  • Team off-sites twice a year: we’ve recently been to the Alps and to Saint-Tropez

 

How we hire

  1. Introductory call with HR (25 min)

  2. Take-home test task

  3. Technical interview with Head of Applied Research (60 min)

  4. Final conversation with our CEO (45 min)
